title: Yemen’s Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia oil tanker
english: Yemen’s Houthi rebels have launched ballistic missile attacks against a Saudi Arabian oil tanker in the Red Sea, claiming the vessel violated a recently imposed maritime blockade. The group states that this action is a direct retaliation against Saudi Arabia for its long-standing economic and military siege on Yemen. While the tanker was forced to retreat, maritime monitors confirmed that the crew remained safe and no environmental damage occurred.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ አማፂያን በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ በሚገኝ የሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ ላይ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ ይህን እርምጃ የወሰደው መርከቧ እነሱ በሳውዲ መርከቦች ላይ የጣሉትን የባህር ላይ እገዳ በመጣሷ ነው ሲል ገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ሳውዲ አረቢያ ለዓመታት በየመን ላይ ጥለዋለች ባሉት እገዳ ላይ ለመበቀል እንደሆነ የቡድኑ ቃል አቀባይ ተናግረዋል። በመርከቧ ላይ ጉዳት ቢደርስም የሰራተኞች ህይወት ደህንነት የተጠበቀ መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Kaayyeewwan Hutiin Yemen gama bahaa, markaba boba’aa kan Sa’udii Arabiyaa qaxxaamura galaana diimaa keessa ture irratti boombiiwwan gurguddaa roobsuun isaanii beekameera. Gareen kun tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame markabichi dhorkaa isaan markaboota Sa’udii irratti kaa’an cabsuu isaatiin akka ta’e ibsaniiru. Hutiin gochi kun kan raawwatame Sa’udiin waggoota hedduuf Yemen irratti dhiibbaa fi dhorkaa waan kaa’teef haaloo ba’uuf akka ta’e dubbatu. Markabichi miidhamus, namoota markaba sana keessa turan irra miidhaan tokko illee akka hin geenye fi balaan naannoo irra hin ga’in mirkanaa’eera.

title: US Centcom says Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles at troops
english: The United States Central Command reported that Iran fired several ballistic missiles at American troops stationed in the Middle East, including a base in Jordan. Fortunately, all the incoming missiles were blocked by defensive systems before reaching their targets. U.S. military forces are continuing to monitor the situation closely and remain prepared for any further threats.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም በቅርቡ ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እና በዮርዳኖስ ለሚገኝ የጦር ሰፈር በርካታ ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን መተኮሷን አስታውቋል። የተተኮሱት ሚሳኤሎች በሙሉ በአሜሪካ መከላከያ ስርዓቶች መክሸፋቸው ተገልጿል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ በማድረግ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa waraana Amerikaa (Centcom) akka ibsetti, Iran giddu galeessa bahaatti buufata waraana Amerikaa fi buufata Yordaanos jiru irratti xiyyaara kombilii (ballistic missiles) hedduu akka itti furgugiste ibseera. Xiyyaarotni kunneen hundinuu sirna ittisaa waraana Amerikaatiin karaa irratti diigamaniiru. Waraanotni Amerikaa ammas haala jiru hordofaa jiranis, of eeggannoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Japan Kumamoto earthquake: What happened, damage, victims, latest updates
english: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake struck Japan's Kyushu island, causing significant destruction including collapsed buildings, fires, and damaged infrastructure. Emergency crews are currently working to rescue those trapped, particularly at a shopping center where a secondary explosion occurred. While a tsunami advisory was briefly issued, it has since been lifted, and officials confirmed that nearby nuclear facilities remain safe.
amharic: የ6.8 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በጃፓን ኩዩሹ ደሴት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የህንጻዎች መፍረስን፣ እሳትንና የመሰረተ ልማት ውድመትን ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በህንጻዎች ስር ተጠልፈው የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ ቢሰጥም በኋላ ላይ ተነስቷል፤ በአካባቢው የሚገኙ የኑክሌር ማመንጫዎችም ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Dambaliin lafaa cimaan 6.8 gahu, ganda Kuushu kan biyya Jaappaan irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Giddu galeessi lafaa kun ijaarsawwan akka diigaman, ibidni akka ka’uufi daandiiwwan akka manca’an taasiseera, akkasumas ogeeyyonni gargaarsa ariifataa namoota ijaarsawwan diigaman jala jiran baasuuf hojjechaa jiru. Gorsi tsunamii jalqaba kenname ture erga haqamee booda, buufataaleen anniisaa niukleerii naannichatti argaman miidhaa akka hin qabne mootummaan mirkaneesseera.

title: Israeli airstrike destroys Gaza City mosque near displacement camp
english: An Israeli airstrike recently struck and demolished the Al-Muttaqin Mosque located in Gaza City. The building was situated right beside an area where many displaced people are currently living in tents near Yarmouk Stadium. Several Palestinians were reported injured by the force of the blast, which caused significant destruction to the site.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በጋዛ ከተማ የሚገኘውን አል-ሙታቂን መስጂድ ቦምብ በመጣል ሙሉ በሙሉ አውድመውታል። መስጂዱ የተመታው በርካታ ተፈናቃዮች በድንኳን ተጠልለው በሚገኙበት የየርሙክ ስታዲየም አቅራቢያ ነው። በዚህ ጥቃት ምክንያት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን የመቁሰል አደጋ ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri waraana Israa'el masjiida Al-Muttaqin kan magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti argamu haleeluun guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Masjiidichi kan rukutame, namoonni buqqa'an hedduun dunkaana keessatti qubatanii kan jiranbuufata istaadiyoomii Yarmuuq bira ture. Humni dhukaasa kanaa namoota Falasxiin hedduu irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiiseera.

title: Kuwait condemns Iranian attacks on country
english: The Kuwaiti government has officially denounced recent attacks carried out by Iran against its territory. Officials described these hostile actions as a significant escalation that endangers the stability of the entire region. This move reflects growing tensions between the two nations and underscores Kuwait's concern for its national security.
amharic: የኩዌት መንግስት በቅርቡ ኢራን በሀገሪቱ ላይ የፈጸመችውን ጥቃት በይፋ አውግዟል። ባለስልጣናቱ እነዚህን ድርጊቶች የክልሉን ሰላምና ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ የሚጥሉ አደገኛ ክስተቶች ሲሉ ገልጸዋቸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Kuweyt weerara Iran biyyattii irratti raawwatte balaaleffannaa cimaan ibseera. Hoggantoonni biyyattii gochi kun nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa kan boorreesse fi sadarkaa irra darbe akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Iran and EU foreign minister hold diplomatic call
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas spoke over the phone on Tuesday. The two officials discussed the current situation in the Middle East and explored potential strategies to lower regional tensions. Their conversation focused on finding ways to ensure lasting security and stability across the area.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ እና የአውሮፓ ህብረት የውጭ ፖሊሲ ሃላፊ ካጃ ካላስ ማክሰኞ ዕለት በስልክ ተነጋገሩ። ሁለቱ ዲፕሎማቶች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ስላለው ወቅታዊ ሁኔታ እና ውጥረትን ለመቀነስ ስለሚረዱ መንገዶች መክረዋል። ውይይታቸው በክልሉ ውስጥ ዘላቂ ሰላምን እና መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchi fi hoogganaan siyaasa alaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa Kaaja Kaalaas guyyaa Kibxata bilbilaan mari'ataniiru. Hojjettoonni kunneen haala yeroo ammaa Baha Giddu-galeessaa fi akkaataa walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa itti hir'isuun danda'amu irratti mari'ataniiru. Mariin isaanii naannicha keessatti nagaa fi tasgabbii buusuu irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: UKMTO reports explosions heard in the southern Red Sea
english: A tanker reported experiencing an explosion while traveling through the southern Red Sea. While the Houthi rebels claimed they attacked a Saudi vessel in the area, the ship's crew is safe and there is no environmental harm. Authorities are monitoring the situation to ensure maritime security in the region.
amharic: አንድ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ በቀይ ባህር ደቡባዊ ክፍል ሲጓዝ ፍንዳታ እንደደረሰበት ዘግቧል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች ደህና እንደሆኑ እና ምንም አይነት የአካባቢ ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ ተረጋግጧል። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው ያለውን የባህር ላይ ደህንነት ሁኔታ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Markaan fe'umsaa tokko bishaan diimaa gara kibbaatti osoo imaluu akka miidhame ibseera. Gareen Huutii ajaja isaanii cabsite jedhee doonii Saudii tokko irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa raawwachuu isaa yoo ibsu iyyuu, hojjettoonni markattii nagaa qabu akkasumas miidhaan naannoo irra gahe tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Aangeyyoonni nageenya bishaanichaa eeguuf haala sana hordofaa jiru.

title: Donald Trump and world leaders attend Lindsey Graham’s funeral
english: President Donald Trump and various international leaders gathered at the Washington National Cathedral to honor the life of the late Senator Lindsey Graham. The long-serving Republican, known for his significant influence on US foreign and domestic policy, passed away unexpectedly earlier in July. During the ceremony, President Trump delivered a eulogy celebrating Graham's legacy as a powerful political figure and a dedicated public servant.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕን ጨምሮ በርካታ የዓለም መሪዎች የረጅም ጊዜ የሴኔት አባል የነበሩትን ሊንዚ ግራሃምን ለማሰናበት በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በተካሄደው የቀብር ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። በጁላይ ወር መጀመሪያ ላይ በድንገት ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩት ግራሃም፣ በአሜሪካ የፖለቲካ እና የውጭ ግንኙነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅእኖ የነበራቸው ሰው ነበሩ። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሥነ-ሥርዓቱ ላይ ባደረጉት ንግግር፣ ግራሃም ለሀገራቸው ላበረከቱት አስተዋፅዖ እና ለነበራቸው ጽናት አድናቆታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonald Tiraamp fi hogganoonni addunyaa gara garaa awwaalcha Senaaterii yeroo dheeraa turan Liinzi Giraaham kabajuuf Waashingitan Diisii keessatti walgahanii turan. Giraaham namoota siyaasaa Ameerikaa keessatti dhiibbaa guddaa qaban keessaa tokko turan; baatii Adooleessaa keessa tasa du'aan addunyaa kanarraa boqatan. title: Iran and Oman exchange proposals to manage Strait of Hormuz
english: Iran and Oman are currently negotiating a new management strategy for the Strait of Hormuz to help stabilize global trade amid ongoing regional conflict. Oman has proposed a collaborative model inspired by the Strait of Malacca, where vessels pay voluntary fees to support navigation and environmental safety. While Iran is in active talks with Oman, they have rejected the proposal for equal transit sharing, insisting instead on maintaining their own security and control over their side of the waterway.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት ተከትሎ ለሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ አዲስ የአስተዳደር ስልት እየነደፉ ነው። ኦማን መርከቦች ለደህንነት እና ለጥበቃ ስራዎች በፈቃደኝነት ክፍያ የሚፈጽሙበትን የማላካ ባህረ ሰላጤን መሰረት ያደረገ ሞዴል አቅርባለች። ይሁን እንጂ ኢራን ይህንን ሀሳብ ውድቅ በማድረግ የራሷን የደህንነት ስጋቶች ለመጠበቅ የራሷን የውሃ መስመር ሙሉ በሙሉ የመቆጣጠር መብቷን ትፈልጋለች።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaanni walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa hordofee karaa bishaan Hormuz sirnaan bulchuuf marii gaggeessaa jiru. Omaanni mootummaan karaa bishaan Malaakaa fakkaatuu fi dooniiwwan tajaajila nageenyaa fi eegumsaa argachuuf kaffaltii fedhii irratti hundaa’e kaffalan akka diriiruuf yaada dhiyeessiteetti. Ta’us, Iraanni yaada kana mormuudhaan, nageenya biyya ishee eeggachuuf jecha karaa bishaan Hormuz naannoo ishee jiru irratti to’annoo guutuu gochuu akka barbaaddu ibsiteetti.

title: Rome’s viral graffiti cleaner is taking on an ancient problem
english: A social media creator is gaining popularity by cleaning graffiti off Rome's historic walls. His actions have sparked a public conversation about the balance between protecting ancient heritage and respecting modern street art. This trend highlights the ongoing struggle to define where urban creative expression ends and property damage begins in an ancient city.
amharic: በሮም የሚገኝ አንድ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተጠቃሚ በታሪካዊ ግድግዳዎች ላይ የተጻፉ የግራፊቲ ስዕሎችን በማጽዳት ተወዳጅነትን እያገኘ ነው። ይህ ተግባሩ የጥንታዊ ቅርሶችን መጠበቅ እና ዘመናዊ የጎዳና ላይ ጥበብን ማክበር መካከል ስላለው ሚዛን በህዝብ ዘንድ ክርክር እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ድርጊቱ በከተማ ውስጥ የፈጠራ ስራ የት እንደሚያበቃ እና የንብረት ውድመት የት እንደሚጀምር ያለውን አለመግባባት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Namni miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti beekamaa ta'e tokko, magaala Roomaa keessatti qofaa isaa qoricha bifa suuraa (graffiti) durii irraa qulqulleessuun xiyyeeffannoo argateera. Gochi isaa kun, eegumsa seenaa fi aartii ammayyaa gidduutti walmadaallii eeguun akkamitti akka danda'amu irratti falmii guddaa uumeera. Namootni kun, ibsa aartii fi miidhaa qabeenyaa gidduu jiru adda baasuun yeroo ammaa irratti rakkisaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Many feared dead from 7.1-magnitude quake in Kumamoto, Japan
english: A major 7.1-magnitude earthquake hit Kumamoto, Japan, resulting in significant structural damage including the collapse of a shopping center and harm to the historic Kumamoto Castle. Many people are feared dead, with numerous others sustaining injuries from the disaster. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has promised that the government will take immediate and comprehensive action to manage the crisis.
amharic: በጃፓን ኩማሞቶ ግዛት የተከሰተው የ7.1 ማግኒቱድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከፍተኛ ውድመትን አስከትሏል። የገበያ ማዕከላት መውደማቸውን እና የኩማሞቶ ቤተመንግስት መጎዳቱን ተከትሎ፣ ብዙ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን እንዳጡ ተሰግቷል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳናዬ ታካኢቺ መንግስት ለችግሩ ፈጣን እና አጠቃላይ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: ጂፓን, ኩማሞቶ keessatti dhibdee lafaa cimaan humni isaa 7.1 ta'e uumamee miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Iddoowwan daldalaa diigamuu fi qoccolloon Kumamoto miidhamuu isaa hordofee, namoonni hedduun du'uu isaanii shakkameera. Muummee Ministiraa Sanae Takaichi mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa fi guutuu ta'e akka taasisu waadaa seenaniiru.

title: Kyiv warns Iran against escalation after Ukraine’s Caspian Sea attack
english: Ukrainian officials contacted their Iranian counterparts to urge a cooling of tensions after a Ukrainian drone strike on a vessel in the Caspian Sea resulted in casualties. While Iran warned that the attack on its commercial ship was unacceptable and requires restitution, Kyiv clarified that the operation was intended for Russian military targets rather than civilians. Ukraine also took the opportunity to demand that Tehran cease its military support for Russia’s ongoing invasion.
amharic: የዩክሬን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በካስፒያን ባህር ውስጥ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት አንድ መርከበኛ መገደሉን ተከትሎ ኢራን ውጥረቱን እንዳታባብስ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ኢራን በንግድ መርከቧ ላይ የደረሰውን ጥቃት እንደማትቀበል እና ካሳ እንደምትፈልግ ገልጻለች፤ ዩክሬን በበኩሏ ጥቃቱ የታለመው የሩሲያ የጦር መርከቦችን እንጂ ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን እንዳልሆነ አስታውቃለች። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ ኪየቭ ኢራን ለሩሲያ የምታደርገውን የጦር መሳሪያ ድጋፍ እንድታቆም አሳስባለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Yukreen markaba biyya Iraan tokko irratti miidhaa qaqqabe ilaalchisee, garee Iraan wajjin mari’achuun walitti buiinsichi akka hin hammaanne akeekkachiiseera. Iraan miidhaa markaba daldalaa ishii irra ga’e akka hin fudhanne ibsuun beenyaa gaafatteetti; Yukreen garuu haleellaan sun kan xiyyeeffate meeshaalee waraana Raashiyaa irratti malee namoota nagaa irratti akka hin taane ibsiteetti. Haaluma kanaan, Yukreen Iraan deeggarsa waraana Raashiyaaf gootu akka dhaabdu jabeessitee gaafatteetti.

title: Netanyahu's quiet visit to Washington highlights Trump's frustration with the leader
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently visited Washington to meet with President Trump ahead of a crucial upcoming election in Israel. The visit was prompted by the death of a key mutual ally, allowing Netanyahu to reinforce his political connection to the US leader. This meeting takes place as Trump engages in multiple high-level discussions with various regional figures, adding pressure to Netanyahu's efforts to secure American support.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በእስራኤል ለሚካሄደው ወሳኝ ምርጫ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት በዋሽንግተን ከፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የተካሄደው በሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል የጋራ ወዳጅ የነበሩ ሰው ህልፈትን ተከትሎ ሲሆን፣ ኔታንያሁ ከትራምፕ ጋር ያላቸውን የቅርብ ግንኙነት ለማሳየት ተጠቅመውበታል። ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ከሌሎች ቀጠናዊ መሪዎች ጋር እያደረጉት ባለው ውይይት ምክንያት፣ የኔታንያሁ ጉብኝት ከፍተኛ ትኩረት አግኝቷል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu filannoo biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamuuf deemuuf hirmaannaa fi deeggarsa Donald Traamp argachuuf gara Waashingitanitti imaluun wal arganiiru. Imalli kun kan godhame erga michuu isaanii tokko du'anii booda yommuu ta'u, Netanyaahuun hariiroo Traamp waliin qaban cimsuuf carraa kana itti fayyadamaniiru. Traamp hogganoota naannoo biroo waliin marii gaggeessaa waan jiraniif, mariin kun Netanyaahuuf dhiibbaa fi xiyyeeffannaa addaa kan qabu ture.

title: Iranian acting defence minister says weapons manufacturing ‘more active than before'
english: Iran's acting defense minister has rejected claims by Donald Trump that American military actions have weakened the country's defense capabilities. He stated that Iran's weapons manufacturing facilities are currently operating at a higher capacity than previously seen. Furthermore, he emphasized that the nation’s technological advancements and the commitment of its scientists to strengthening the military are growing.
amharic: የኢራን ጊዜያዊ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር የአሜሪካ ጥቃቶች የኢራንን ወታደራዊ አቅም አዳክመዋል የሚለውን የዶናልድ ትራምፕን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የኢራን የጦር መሳሪያ ማምረቻ መስመሮች ከበፊቱ በበለጠ ፍጥነትና አቅም እየሰሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም የአገሪቱ ቴክኖሎጂ እየዘመነ መምጣቱን እና የኢራን ሳይንቲስቶች የመከላከያ አቅማቸውን ለመገንባት ያላቸው ቁርጠኝነት ከምንጊዜውም በላይ ጠንካራ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: ministirri ittisa biyyaa kan Iran, humni waraana Iran haleellaa Ameerikaatiin laafateera jechuun Donald Trump himata dhiyeessan haalaniiru. Innis oomishni meeshaa waraana Iran ammaa kana kanaan dura irra kan caalu ta'uu fi hojiin isaas si'ataa deemuu ibseera. Akkasumas, Iran teeknooloojii ammayyaatti fayyadamuun fi ogeeyyonni biyyattii dandeettii ittisa biyyaa cimsuuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneesseera.

title: US official says Iran making 'unreasonable demands' for Hormuz fees
english: A US official has stated that there will be no fees charged for vessels traveling through the Strait of Hormuz during current ceasefire negotiations. The United States and Oman have both dismissed recent requests from Iran to implement tolls and gain more oversight of the waterway. These proposals were considered irrational and were formally rejected by the involved parties.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣን በአሁኑ ጊዜ እየተካሄደ ባለው የተኩስ አቁም ድርድር ወቅት በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል ለሚያልፉ መርከቦች ምንም አይነት ክፍያ እንደማይኖር አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን በውሃ መስመሩ ላይ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ ያቀረበችው የክፍያ ጥያቄ በአሜሪካ እና በኦማን ውድቅ ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናቱ የኢራንን ጥያቄ ምክንያታዊ ያልሆነ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Ameerikaa marii yeroo ammaa gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee, markabni tokkollee lafa Hoomuz keessa yeroo darban kaffaltii kamiyyuu akka hin kaffalle ibsaniiru. Iiraan karaa bishaanii kana irratti to'annoo caalu argachuuf kaffaltii akka gaafattu yaada dhiyeessite ture, ta'us mootummoonni Ameerikaa fi Omaaniin gaaffii kana fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Dhimmi kunis kutaaleen kunneen yaada Iiraan dhiyeessite akka hin fudhatamne ibsaniiru.

title: Netanyahu's quiet visit to Washington highlights Trump's frustration with the leader
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently visited Washington for a private meeting with President Donald Trump to reinforce their alliance ahead of Israel's upcoming election. While both leaders publicly described the talks as positive, reports suggest underlying tensions regarding Netanyahu’s push for continued military action against Iran. Analysts observe that Trump is currently balancing regional interests, leading to frustrations over Netanyahu's insistence on escalating the conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በእስራኤል ለሚካሄደው ምርጫ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለማጠናከር ከፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ለመወያየት ዋሽንግተን ተገኝተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱም መሪዎች ንግግራቸውን አወንታዊ እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃን ለመቀጠል በኔታንያሁ ግፊት ምክንያት በመካከላቸው አለመግባባት እንዳለ ይጠቁማል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ትራምፕ ቀጠናዊ ግንኙነቶችን ሚዛን ለመጠበቅ እየሞከሩ ሲሆን፣ ኔታንያሁ ግጭቱን ለማባባስ የሚያሳዩት ፍላጎት በፕሬዝዳንቱ ዘንድ ቅሬታን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahu filannoo Israa'el dhufuuf jiruuf deeggarsa argachuuf jecha, Waashington dhaquun Pireezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp waliin mari'ataniiru. Hogganoonni lamaanuu mariin isaanii bu'a qabeessa ture jedhanii kan ibsan ta'us, Netanyaahu Itiyoophiyaa wajjin wal qabatee duula waraanaa ittifufsiisuuf dhiibbaa godhuun isaanii wal dhabbii keessoo akka jiru agarsiisa. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, Tiraamp fedhii naannichaa wal madaalchisuuf yaalaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, dhiibbaan Netanyaahu gombisa waraanaa guddisuuf godhan kun garuu Pireezidaanticha biratti mufannaa uumera.

title: Tebboune says Algeria will stand by Tunisia against 'any threat'
english: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has pledged to protect Tunisia from any external threats, declaring that an assault on his neighbor would be considered an attack on Algeria itself. He hinted that unnamed actors are attempting to isolate and destabilize Tunisia, though he did not specify who he believes is responsible. This security commitment reinforces the deepening political and military alliance between the two nations amidst Tunisia's current internal power crisis.
amharic: የአልጄሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት አብደልማጂድ ተቡን፣ ቱኒዚያን ከማንኛውም የውጭ ስጋት ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገለጹ። በቱኒዚያ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በአልጄሪያ ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ እንደሚቆጠርም አስታውቀዋል። የተወሰኑ አካላት ቱኒዚያን ለመነጠል እና ለማዳከም እየሞከሩ እንደሆነ የጠቆሙት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ምንም እንኳን ስማቸውን ባይጠቅሱም አገራቸው ለጎረቤቷ ደህንነት የቆመች መሆኗን አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ንግግር በአሁኑ ወቅት ቱኒዚያ ውስጥ ካለው የኤሌክትሪክ ችግር እና የውስጥ ፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ጋር በተያያዘ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የጠበቀ የደህንነት ትብብር የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Aljeeriyaa Abdelmaajiid Tebbuun, biyyi isaanii biyya ollaa isaanii Tuuniziyaa miidhaa kam irraa iyyuu eeguuf waadaa galaniiru. Tuuniziyaa irratti miidhaan kam iyyuu akka isaan irratti miidhaa geessisetti akka lakkaa'amu ibsaniiru. Qaamni maqaan isaanii hin ibsamne tokko Tuuniziyaa addaan baasuufi diiguuf yaalaa akka jiran kan dubbatan yoo ta'u, Aljeeriyaan nagaa Tuuniziyaa kabachiisuuf cichitee akka dhaabbattu mirkaneessaniiru. Ibsi kun waldhabdee elektirikii fi rakkoo siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti mudateen walqabatee, hariiroo cimaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: New poll shows confusion over Democratic Socialists of America ideals
english: A recent poll indicates that nearly half of Americans remain unclear about the goals and policies of the Democratic Socialists of America, despite the group's recent electoral successes. While members like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez are winning primaries, many voters express skepticism about their proposed ideas. This uncertainty highlights the significant communication challenges facing these progressive politicians as they continue to gain influence in the US political landscape.
amharic: አዲስ የተደረገ የሕዝብ አስተያየት ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው፣ የዲሞክራቲክ ሶሻሊስቶች በምርጫ ድል እየተቀዳጁ ቢሆንም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን የቡድኑን ዓላማና ፖሊሲዎች በግልጽ እንደማያውቁት ያሳያል። እንደ አሌክሳንድሪያ ኦካሲዮ-ኮርቴዝ ያሉ የቡድኑ አባላት በምርጫ እያሸነፉ ቢሆንም፣ ብዙ መራጮች በእነርሱ ሀሳብ ላይ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። ይህ ክፍተት በፖለቲካው ውስጥ ተፅዕኖ እየፈጠሩ ባሉት የግራ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች ላይ የሚታየውን ከፍተኛ የግንኙነት ፈተና ያሳያል።
oromo: qorannoon dhiheenya kana taasifame akka agarsiisutti, gareen Soshaalistoota Diimookiraatawaa Ameerikaa kun injifannoo filannoo argachaa jiraatus, namoonni Ameerikaa hedduun waa'ee kaayyoo fi imaammata garee kanaa hubannoo gahaa hin qaban. Miseensonni akka Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez filannoo keessatti yoo mo'atanillee, namoonni hedduun yaada isaanii irratti shakki qabu. Kunis, siyaasa Ameerikaa keessatti humni isaanii dabalaa kan jiru ta'us, siyaasaonni kunniin yaada isaanii ibsuu irratti qormaata guddaa keessa akka jiran agarsiisa.

title: What will it take to stop the conflict in Sudan?
english: The ongoing three-year conflict between the Sudanese army and the Rapid Support Forces has triggered a massive humanitarian crisis, leaving millions displaced and the country's infrastructure destroyed. While the army recently secured a strategic highway near El-Obeid, the civilian population remains in grave danger as the fighting continues. Both sides face accusations of war crimes, and urgent solutions are needed to address the collapse of essential services and the widespread need for aid.
amharic: በሱዳን ጦር እና በፍጥነት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች (RSF) መካከል ለሦስት ዓመታት የቆየው ግጭት ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ አስከትሏል። ሚሊዮኖች ከቀያቸው የተፈናቀሉ ሲሆን የአገሪቱ መሠረተ ልማቶችና የጤና አገልግሎቶች ሙሉ በሙሉ ወድመዋል። የመንግስት ጦር በኤል-ኦቤድ አካባቢ ስትራቴጂካዊ መንገድ መቆጣጠሩ ቢነገርም፣ የሲቪል ህዝቡ ስቃይ አሁንም ቀጥሏል፤ ሁለቱም ወገኖች በጦር ወንጀል ክስ እየቀረበባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Waraanni waggaa sadiif Itoophiyaa ollaatti argamtu Sudaan keessatti loltuu biyyattii fi garee RSF gidduutti adeemsifamaa jiru balaa namoomaa guddaa geessisee jira. Namoonni miliyoona 13 ol ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii, tajaajilli bu'uuraa fi barnootni guutummaatti dhaabbatee jira. Waraanni biyyattii karaa barbaachisaa ta'e tokko to'achuun isaa himamee jiraatus, namoonni hedduun harka diinaa jiruufi miidhaan hamaa irratti geessifamaa jira.

title: West Bank quarry owner appeals to Trump after settler raid
english: A Palestinian-American business owner is requesting assistance from President Trump following a violent attack by Israeli settlers on his quarry in the West Bank. During the incident, the attackers caused significant damage by setting machinery on fire and assaulting security personnel. This event is part of a recent surge in settler-led violence throughout the occupied region.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኝ የኳሪ ባለቤት የሆኑ ፍልስጤማዊ-አሜሪካዊው፣ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች በደረሰባቸው ጥቃት ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ጣልቃ እንዲገቡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ጥቃቱ የደረሰው ሰፋሪዎች ማሽኖችን በማቃጠል እና በጠባቂዎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ በቅርቡ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ተከትሎ የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa bakka dhagaa baasuu (quarry) kan ta'an lammii Falasxiin-Ameerikaa tokko, qabeenya isaanii irratti weerartoonni Israa'el miidhaa erga geessisanii booda, pirezidaant Traamp akka gidduu seenan gaafatan. Weerartoonni kun meeshalee hojii ibiddaan barbadeessanii fi eegdota irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Miidhaan kun kan hordofe guddina jeequmsa weerartoonni naannichatti geggeessaa jiran keessatti dha.

title: Israeli forces strike towns in southern Lebanon’s Tyre district again
english: Israeli military forces have resumed airstrikes and building demolitions in several towns within southern Lebanon's Tyre district. These attacks persist despite a previous framework agreement intended to halt such hostilities. The ongoing actions indicate that military operations in the region remain active regardless of prior diplomatic commitments.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ የታይር አውራጃ ከተሞች ላይ ዳግም የአየር ጥቃት እና የህንፃ ማፍረስ ስራዎችን አከናውነዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ቀደም ሲል የተደረሰውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ችላ በማለት የቀጠሉ ናቸው። ይህም በክልሉ ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስምምነቶች ቢኖርም መቀጠሉን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gandaalee kibba Libaanos, naannoo Tyre keessatti argaman irratti duula qilleensaafi diiggaa mana hojjechaa jiru. Haleellaan kun walii galtee nagaa dura taasifame kan cabsee itti fufe dha. Gochi kun walii galtee dipiloomaasii duratti taasifame osoo jiruu, waraanni naannichatti itti fufuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Trump hails late US Senator Lindsey Graham as 'true American original'
english: World leaders, including President Zelensky and Prime Minister Netanyahu, attended the funeral of former US Senator Lindsey Graham in Washington. During the service, Donald Trump praised Graham as a loyal friend and a devoted advocate for robust American military strength. Trump noted Graham’s long-standing support for international conflicts, highlighting his commitment to the country's global influence.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ እና የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኔታንያሁ በዋሽንግተን በተካሄደው የሴናተር ሊንዚ ግራሃም የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። በዚህ ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ንግግር ያደረጉት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ግራሃም ለሀገራቸው ወታደራዊ ብርታት የነበራቸው ቁርጠኝነት የሚደነቅ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ትራምፕ ሴናተሩን ታማኝ ጓደኛ እና የአሜሪካን ኃይል በዓለም ላይ ለማስጠበቅ የቆሙ ሰው ሲሉ አወድሰዋቸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukreen Zeelenskii fi Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'eel Neetanyaahuu sirna awwaalcha Senaater Liinzi Giraaham kan Waashingitanitti geggeeffame irratti argamaniiru. Donald Tiraamp sirna kana irratti haasaa taasisaniin, Giraaham michuu amanamaa fi humna waraanaa Ameerikaa jabeessuuf kan hojjete ta'uu dubbataniiru. Tiraamp, Giraaham dhiibbaa Ameerikaa addunyaa irratti guddisuuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaa fi waraana irratti ilaalcha gaarii qabaachuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi defence ministry says it intercepted Iraqi drones targeting oil facilities
english: Saudi Arabian military officials reported that their air defense systems successfully shot down multiple drones originating from Iraq. These unmanned aircraft were reportedly attempting to strike oil infrastructure situated in the eastern part of the country. No damage was reported following the interception of the aerial attack.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ከኢራቅ አቅጣጫ የተላኩ በርካታ ድሮኖችን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ድሮኖቹ በሀገሪቱ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል በሚገኙ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር ታቅደው የነበሩ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል። የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊቱ ጥቃቱን በማክሸፉ በንብረት ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii Arabiyaa qilleensarraa ittisuu isaa fayyadamuun xiyyaarota nama hin qabne kan Iraaqirraa dhufan baay'ee barbadeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Xiyyaarotni kun naannoo bahaatti kan argaman iddoowwan qulqulleeffannoo boba'aa irratti xiyyeeffatanii turan. Ittisuu kanarratti miidhaan qabeenyaa irra ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: UN: Political process cannot succeed while Gaza remains devastated, violence escalates in West Bank
english: The United Nations has emphasized that long-term stability in the region is impossible without a functioning political process. Officials highlighted that the ongoing destruction in Gaza and rising violence in the West Bank create conditions that make peace efforts unsustainable. They further warned that the shrinking territory for civilians and worsening security situation must be addressed to allow for any meaningful progress.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ውጤታማ የፖለቲካ ሂደት ሳይኖር በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ማምጣት እንደማይቻል አስታውቋል። በጋዛ እየደረሰ ያለው ውድመት እና በዌስት ባንክ እየተባባሰ ያለው ግጭት ለሰላም ጥረቶች ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሆኑ ተጠቁሟል። ለሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ያለው የመኖሪያ ቦታ እየጠበበ መምጣት እና የፀጥታው ሁኔታ መባባስ የፖለቲካ መፍትሄን አስቸጋሪ እያደረገው መሆኑን ድርጅቱ አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa adeemsi siyaasaa utuu hin jiru nagaan dhaabbataan naannichatti dhufuu akka hin dandeenye ibseera. Gaza keessatti mancaatii geeffamaa jiru fi naannoo West Bank keessatti waldhabdee dabalaa jiru carraaqqii nagaa hundaaf gufuu ta'uu ibsameera. Bakki jiraattootaaf hafe xiqqaachaa dhufuun fi haalli nageenyaa gadhiisuniis furmaata siyaasaa akka hin dandeessisne dhaabbatichi akeekkachiiseera.

title: Iran says it seeks 'restitution' for Ukrainian attacks on vessel
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Ukraine has apologized for an unintentional strike on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea. While both nations have agreed to avoid further military escalation, Iran is demanding financial compensation for the damages incurred. During their conversation, the Ukrainian official also urged Iran to stop providing military support to Russia.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ዩክሬን በካስፒያን ባህር ውስጥ ለሚገኝ የኢራን መርከብ በአጋጣሚ ለደረሰው ጥቃት ይቅርታ መጠየቋን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ግጭትን ላለማባባስ የተስማሙ ቢሆንም፣ ኢራን ለደረሰው ጉዳት ካሳ እንዲከፈል ትጠይቃለች። በዚሁ ንግግራቸው ወቅት የዩክሬን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኢራን ለሩሲያ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንድታቆም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan Abbas Araqchii akka ibsetti, Yukireen doonii Iraan galaana Kaspian keessatti argamtu irratti balaa tasaan qaqqabeef dhiifama gaafatteetti. Biyyoonni lamaan walitti bu’iinsa biroo ittisuuf walii galan illee, Iraan miidhaa qaqqabeef kaffaltii beenyaa akka barbaaddu ibsiteetti. Marii isaanii kanaan, ministirri Yukireen Iraan deeggarsa waraanaa Raashiyaaf gootu akka dhaabdu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a National Dialogue aimed at addressing long-standing political issues, but many in the Somali Region are skeptical of the process. They worry that the discussions could be used to weaken the current federal system and the constitutional protections that safeguard their self-determination. Despite feeling marginalized by the central government, they strongly support the existing federal framework and fear any moves toward increased centralization.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የረጅም ጊዜ የፖለቲካ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት ያለመ ሀገራዊ ምክክር የጀመረች ቢሆንም፣ በሶማሌ ክልል የሚገኙ ብዙ ወገኖች በሂደቱ ላይ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። የዚህ ውይይት ዓላማ አሁን ያለውን የፌዴራል ሥርዓት እና የራስን ዕድል በራስ የመወሰን መብትን የሚያረጋግጠውን ሕገ መንግሥት ለማዳከም ይውላል የሚል ስጋት አድሮባቸዋል። በፌዴራል መንግሥት ተهمለናል ብለው ቢያምኑም፣ አሁን ያለውን የፌዴራል ሥርዓት እንደሚደግፉ እና ወደ ማዕከላዊ አስተዳደር የሚያደላ ለውጥ እንደሚያሰጋቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan rakkoolee siyaasaa biyyattii furuuf marii biyyaalessaa kan jalqabde yoo ta'u, namoonni naannoo Somaalee keessa jiran hedduun garuu adeemsa kana shakku. Mariin kun sirna federaalaa ammaa fi mirga ofiin of bulchuu kan kabachiisu seera bu'uuraa laaffisuuf itti fayyadamaa jiru jechuun sodaatu. Mootummaan federaalaa cunqursaa irra ga'aa jiru akka jiru kan amananii fi sirna federaalaa ammaa kan deggaran ta'us, gara giddu-galeessaatti deebi'uun mootummaa of jajuun sodaachisaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Ghana mourns its tallest man - a 'generous and popular giant'
english: Sulemana Abdul Samed, widely known as Ghana's tallest man, has passed away at the age of 33 following complications from a leg infection. Standing at over seven feet tall due to gigantism caused by Marfan syndrome, he was a beloved figure and a local icon in his hometown of Gambaga. Despite receiving medical support for his condition, he died suddenly in a hospital in Tamale, leaving his community in deep mourning.
amharic: የጋና ረጅሙ ሰው በመባል የሚታወቀው ሱሌማና አብዱል ሳሜድ በእግር ኢንፌክሽን ህመም ምክንያት በ33 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። ማርፋን ሲንድሮም በተባለ የጤና እክል ምክንያት ቁመቱ ከሰባት ጫማ በላይ የነበረው ሱሌማና፣ በትውልድ ከተማው ጋምባጋ ትልቅ ክብርና ፍቅር የነበረው ሰው ነበር። ለህመሙ የህክምና እርዳታ እየተደረገለት ቢሆንም በታማሌ ሆስፒታል ባጋጠመው ድንገተኛ ሞት መላው ማህበረሰቡ በሃዘን ተውጧል።
oromo: Namichi Ganaa keessatti dheeraa ture Sulemaanaa Abdul Saamed, umrii isaa waggaa 33tti dhukkuba miilla isaa irratti mudateen du'aan boqoteera. Dhukkuba 'Marfan syndrome' jedhamuun qabamee dheerinni isaa meetira lamaa fi seentimeetira 23 kan ga'u Sulemaanaa, magaalatti isaa Gambaagaatti nama baay'ee jaallatamuufi beekamu ture. Wal’ansa fayyaa argachaa tureyyuu, mana yaala magaalaa Taamaaleetti tasa du’uun isaa uummata biratti gadda guddaa uumeera.

title: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
english: Renowned translator Emily Wilson has published a harsh critique of Christopher Nolan's new film adaptation of The Odyssey. Although the movie is a commercial success, Wilson criticized the screenplay as shallow and lacking emotional depth. However, she expressed gratitude for the director's role in encouraging the public to read classic literature and bringing audiences back to theaters.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ ተርጓሚ ኤሚሊ ዊልሰን የክሪስቶፈር ኖላንን አዲስ የፊልም ስራ 'ኦዲሲ'ን በማጥላላት ጠንካራ ትችት ሰንዝረዋል። ፊልሙ በገበያ ላይ ስኬታማ ቢሆንም፣ ዊልሰን የስክሪፕቱን ጥራት መውደቅ እና የገጸ-ባህሪያቱን ጥልቀት ማጣት ተችተዋል። ሆኖም፣ ፊልሙ የጥንታዊ ስነ-ጽሁፍ መጽሃፍትን ተወዳጅነት በመጨመር ህዝብን ወደ ሲኒማ ቤት እንዲመለስ ማድረጉን አድንቀዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun hiikaa beekamaan Emilii Wiilson fiilmii haarawa Kristoofar Noolan kan 'Oodiiisii' jedhamu irratti qeeqa cimaa dhiheessiteetti. Fiilmichi gabaa irratti milkaa'ina guddaa gonfatee jiraatus, Wiilson barreffamni fiilmichaa gad-fageenyaafi miira kan hin qabne ta'uu isaa dubbatteetti. Ta'us, fiilmichi dubbifattoota gara barruuwwan durii deebisuufi namoonni gara sinimaatti akka deebi'an taasisuu isaa galata galchiteetti.

title: ‘The dream I carried is gone’: Miscarriages rise amid trauma of Gaza’s war
english: Doctors in Gaza report a significant increase in miscarriages, attributing nearly 70% of these pregnancy losses to the ongoing war, forced displacement, and severe lack of resources. Expectant mothers are suffering from extreme malnutrition, constant fear, and the collapse of medical services, making it nearly impossible to sustain healthy pregnancies. Many women, like Nuha Abu Lebda, have faced multiple heartbreaks after losing their babies due to these dire living conditions.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ዶክተሮች የእርግዝና መቋረጥ መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን ገልጸው፣ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ ወደ 70 በመቶ የሚሆኑት ከጦርነቱ፣ ከማፈናቀል እና ከመድኃኒት እጦት ጋር የተያያዙ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ነፍሰ ጡር እናቶች በከባድ የምግብ እጥረት፣ በስነ-ልቦና ጭንቀት እና የጤና አገልግሎት በመውደሙ ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ ስቃይ ተዳርገዋል። እንደ ኑሃ አቡ ለብዳ ያሉ ብዙ እናቶች አስቸጋሪ በሆነው የጦርነት ሁኔታ ምክንያት ህጻናቸውን እያጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni fayyaa Gaazaa keessatti baay'inni ulfa ba'uu dabalaa dhufuu isaa ibsanii, kana keessaa 70% kan ta'u waraana, buqqaatii fi hanqina tajaajila fayyaa wajjin kan walqabatu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Haadholiin ulfa ta'an dhabama nyaataa, sodaa fi manca'iinsa dhaabbilee fayyaa irraa kan ka'e rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru. Akka Nuhaa Abuu Lebdaa kanneen ta'an haadholiin hedduun haala waraanaa kanaan walqabatee ijoollee isaanii dhabuun gadda guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Malaysian foreign minister calls for review of UNHCR’s presence
english: Malaysia's foreign minister is calling for a potential reassessment of the UNHCR's role in the country due to concerns over how refugee documents are issued. The government wants tighter cooperation and stricter screening procedures to manage the influx of asylum seekers more effectively. This demand follows the recent detention of over 100 Rohingya refugees in Kuala Lumpur, highlighting growing tensions regarding the agency's current operations.
amharic: የማሌዢያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNHCR) የስደተኞች ሰነዶችን በሚሰጥበት ሂደት ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። መንግስት የስደተኞችን ፍሰት ለመቆጣጠር ከኤጀንሲው ጋር በጋራ መስራት እንደሚፈልግ እና ይህም ካልሆነ ኤጀንሲው በሀገሪቱ ያለውን መገኘት እንደገና ማጤን እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልፀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በኩዋላ ላምፑር ከ100 በላይ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች ከታሰሩ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በኤጀንሲው አሰራር ላይ ያለው አለመግባባት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri dhimmi alaa Maleezhiyaa dhaabbanni baqattootaa tokkummaa mootummootaa (UNHCR) waajjira isaa keessatti eenyummaa baqattootaa kennuu irratti to’annoo cimaa akka godhu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan rakkoo baqattootaa sirnaan bulchuuf UNHCR wajjin waliin hojjechuu akka barbaadu fi akkaataa kanaan duratti hojjetamuun itti fufuu akka hin dandeenye ibseera. Murtii kana kan fidus baqattoota Rohinga 100 ol ta’an magaala Kuaalaalampuuritti erga qabamaniin booda, haala hojii UNHCR irratti mormiin guddaan ka’uun isaa ti.

title: ‘No freedom at all’: Israeli closures leave West Bank patients trapped
english: Following a large-scale military operation in the West Bank, Israeli forces have imposed tight closures and roadblocks that severely hinder medical access. Ambulance drivers are facing hours of delays at checkpoints, forcing them to take long detours and endangering patients who need urgent care. These restrictions are making it nearly impossible for people in critical condition to reach essential hospital services in cities like Nablus.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ በተካሄደው መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ተከትሎ፣ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች የጣሉት ጥብቅ የጉዞ ገደብ እና ፍተሻዎች የሕክምና አገልግሎትን ክፉኛ አግደዋል። የአምቡላንስ አሽከርካሪዎች በኬላዎች ላይ ለረጅም ሰዓታት በመቆየታቸው ታማሚዎች ወደ ሆስፒታል ለመድረስ ረጅም መንገድ እንዲጓዙ እና ለአደጋ እንዲጋለጡ ተገደዋል። እነዚህ የጉዞ ገደቦች በተለይም በአስቸኳይ ህክምና የሚያስፈልጋቸው ሰዎች እንደ ናቡሉስ ባሉ ከተሞች የሚገኙ የጤና ተቋማትን እንዳያገኙ እያደረጋቸው ነው።
oromo: Humni Israa'eel naannoo Zoonii Lixaa keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeesseen walqabatee, daandiiwwan cufuun tajaajila fayyaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira. Ogeeyyonni ambuulansii bakka sakatta'iinsaa irratti sa'aatii dheeraaf waan qabamaniif, dhukkubsattoota gara hospitaalaa geessuun ulfaataa ta'ee jira. Gochi kun dhukkubsattoonni xiyyeeffannoo ariifachiisaa barbaadan hospitaalota magaalaa Naabulus jiran akka hin geenye godhee, lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilaa jira.

title: Uganda declares end to Ebola outbreak
english: Ugandan health officials have officially declared the country free of Ebola after passing 42 days without any new infections. Although the outbreak is over, the government is advising citizens to stay vigilant because a severe epidemic continues to affect the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. During the local outbreak, 20 cases were reported, resulting in two deaths.
amharic: የዩጋንዳ የጤና ባለስልጣናት በሀገሪቱ ምንም አይነት አዲስ የኢቦላ በሽታ ወረርሽኝ ሳይከሰት 42 ቀናት በመቆጠሩ፣ ሀገሪቱ ከኢቦላ ነፃ መሆኗን በይፋ አውጀዋል። ወረርሽኙ ቢቆምም መንግስት አጎራባች በሆነችው ኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የኢቦላ ስርጭት እየተባባሰ በመሆኑ ህዝቡ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል። በዩጋንዳ በተከሰተው በዚህ ወረርሽኝ 20 ሰዎች በቫይረሱ የተያዙ ሲሆን ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni fayyaa Yugaandaa guyyoota 42f vaayirasichi erga mul’achuu dhaabatee booda, biyyattii vaayirasii Ibolaa irraa bilisa ta’uu isaanii labsaniiru. Gabaasichi kan xumurame ta’us, biyya ollaa Kongootti vaayirasichi daran babal’achaa waan jiruuf mootummaan ummanni akka of eeggannoo godhu gorseera. Yugaandaa keessatti namoonni 20 vaayirasichaan qabamanii, isaan keessaa lama lubbuun darbeera.

title: Lindsey Graham ‘almost cried’ tears of joy over war on Iran, footage shows
english: Recently released documentary footage reveals that the late Senator Lindsey Graham took personal credit for convincing Donald Trump to initiate a war against Iran alongside Israel. In the recording, Graham expressed immense joy over the military campaign, noting that he nearly shed tears of happiness when it began. The senator also revealed that he encouraged Trump to support further military actions in Lebanon while acting as a bridge between the American president and Benjamin Netanyahu.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የሆነ የቪዲዮ መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው፣ አሁን በህይወት የሌሉት ሴናተር ሊንድሴ ግርሃም፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከእስራኤል ጋር በመሆን በኢራን ላይ ጦርነት እንዲያውጁ ለማሳመን የራሳቸውን ሚና እንደተጫወቱ ተናግረዋል። ግርሃም ጦርነቱ ሲጀመር በደስታ እንባ እስኪቃርባቸው ድረስ እንደተሰማቸው በቪዲዮው ላይ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እና በእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መካከል የነበሩትን ግንኙነቶች በማቀናጀት ትራምፕ በሊባኖስ ላይም ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ይገፋፉ እንደነበር ተጋልጧል።
oromo: Suurri fi sagaleen suuraa haaraa bahe akka agarsiisutti, seenaatara duraanii kan turan Liindsee Giraaham, doonald tiraampii fi Israa'el waraana Iraan irratti akka banan gochuuf ofiisaanii akka gumaachan dubbataniiru. Giraaham waraanni kun yeroo jalqabame gammachuu guddaa itti dhaga'amee, imimmaannii gammachuu akka isaan qabates qaxxaamuraan ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, seenaatarichi tiraampii fi banyaamiin Netaanyaahuu gidduutti ta'uun, tiraampiin biyya Liibaanoos irrattis tarkaanfii waraanaa akka fudhatan jajjabeessaa akka turan ifa ta'eera.

title: Senior source says Trump, Netanyahu discussed ensuring Iran never possessed nuclear weapons
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and US President Donald Trump held a highly productive meeting in Washington. During their discussion, both leaders focused on major regional topics, with a primary emphasis on the Iranian nuclear threat. They both pledged to work together to guarantee that Iran is prevented from ever acquiring nuclear weapons.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዋሽንግተን ተገናኝተው ገንቢ ውይይት አድርገዋል። መሪዎቹ በወቅታዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ በስፋት የተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ ዋና ትኩረታቸውም የኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ነበር። ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል በጋራ ለመስራት ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahunii fi Preezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doolard Tiraamp Waashingitanitti wal arguun marii bu'aa qabeessa ta'e taasisaniiru. Hogganoonni lamaan dhimmoota yeroo irratti bal'inaan kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, xiyyeeffannoon isaanii inni guddaan rakkoo niwukilara Iiraan ture. Iiraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf waliin hojjechuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Qatar condemns renewed attacks on Jordan
english: Qatar has officially denounced the recent Iranian strikes against Jordan, describing the military action as a serious threat to stability in the region. The Qatari government labeled these attacks a violation of international law and Jordanian sovereignty. Officials in Doha have urged an immediate end to all military hostilities to prevent further escalation.
amharic: ኳታር በዮርዳኖስ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የኢራን ጥቃት አውግዛለች፤ ጥቃቱ የክልሉን ሰላም ለአደጋ የሚጋብዝ አደገኛ ድርጊት መሆኑን ገልጻለች። የኳታር መንግስት ድርጊቱ የአለም አቀፍ ህግን እና የዮርዳኖስን ሉዓላዊነት የሚጥስ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ሁኔታው እንዳይባባስም ሁሉም ወገኖች ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን እንዲያቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Qatar hujii waraanaa dhiyeenya kana gara Yordaanositti taasifame kan balaaleffatte yoo ta'u, gochi kun tasgabbii naannichaa miidhuu danda'a jetteetti. Mootummaan Qatar qaqqabiin kun seera idil-addunyaa fi mirga abbaa biyyummaa Yordaanos kan sarbu ta'uu ibseera. Akkasumas, rakkinichi akka hin hammaanneef gareewwan marti waraana akka dhaaban gaafateera.

title: Anger rises as ICC member states accused of facilitating Netanyahu’s flight to Washington
english: Critics are calling out several nations for allowing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to fly through their airspace during his recent trip to Washington. These countries, including Greece, Italy, France, and Canada, are members of the International Criminal Court, which issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu in 2024 regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza. Observers argue that these governments failed to fulfill their legal obligations by not obstructing the travel of a wanted individual.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በቅርቡ ወደ ዋሽንግተን ባደረጉት ጉዞ የአለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት አባል የሆኑ ሀገራት የአየር ክልላቸውን እንዲጠቀሙ መፍቀዳቸው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። ግሪክ፣ ጣሊያን፣ ፈረንሳይ እና ካናዳ በ2024 በኔታንያሁ ላይ በጋዛ የጦር ወንጀል ፈጽመዋል በሚል የእስር ማዘዣ ያወጣውን ፍርድ ቤት ህግ የመከተል ግዴታ አለባቸው። ተቺዎች እነዚህ መንግስታት የተፈለገ ግለሰብን ለመያዝ ወይም ለመከልከል ያላቸውን አለም አቀፍ ግዴታ በመጣስ ተባባሪ ሆነዋል ሲሉ ይወቅሳሉ።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu yeroo gara Waashingitan imalanitti, biyyoonni miseensa Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) ta'an qilleensa isaanii akka fayyadamu hayyamuun isaanii mormii cimaa kaasera. Biyyoonni kunniin, kanneen akka Girees, Xaaliyaanii, Faransaay fi Kaanaadaa, mana murtichaa kan bara 2024 Netanyaahu irratti yakka waraanaa fi namoomaa irratti raawwatamaniin murtee hidhaa dabarse kabajuuf dirqama qabu. Qeeqtonni mootummoonni kunniin nama barbaadamaa jiru tokko ittisuu dhiisuun, dirqama seeraa idil-addunyaa isaanii akka hin ba'in dubbatu.

title: Iran has ‘no plans’ to negotiate with US, deputy foreign minister says
english: Iran's deputy foreign minister has officially stated that the country has no intention of entering into negotiations with the United States. He criticized Washington for trying to dictate the terms of engagement and insisted that Iran would not allow the U.S. to choose when to fight or talk. Meanwhile, Iran is continuing separate, incremental discussions with Oman regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የኢራን ምክትል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ከአሜሪካ ጋር ለመደራደር ምንም ዓይነት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው በግልጽ ተናገሩ። ዋሽንግተን በፈለገችው ጊዜ ጦርነት እየከፈተች በፈለገችው ጊዜ ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ መምጣት እንደሌለባትም ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ውጪ፣ ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን መልሶ ለመክፈት ከኦማን ጋር በሂደት ላይ ያሉ ንግግሮች እንዳሏት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun ministira dhimma alaa Iraan, biyyi isaanii Ameerikaa waliin marii gochuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Washington yeroo feetetti waraana bantee yeroo feetetti ammoo marii gochuuf yaaluun ishee dogoggora ta'uu himaniiru. Ta'us, Iraan karaa biyya Omaan immoo dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz banuu ilaalchisee marii gaggeessaa jirti.

title: Iran backs Volker Turk reappointment to UN rights chief
english: Iran has officially expressed its support for Volker Turk to serve a second term as the UN human rights chief. This endorsement comes despite notable opposition from the United States, Israel, and Russia. Tehran praised Turk for his commitment to addressing serious international crimes, highlighting his focus on conflicts in Gaza and Ukraine.
amharic: ኢራን ቮልከር ቱርክ በተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነርነት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲመረጡ ድጋፏን ሰጥታለች። ይህ ድጋፍ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ፣ እስራኤል እና ሩሲያ ቱርክን በመቃወም ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ኢራን፣ ኮሚሽነሩ በጋዛ እና በዩክሬን እየተፈጸሙ ያሉ አለም አቀፍ ወንጀሎችን በመቃወም ረገድ ላሳዩት ቁርጠኝነት አድናቆቷን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Iiraan ቮልከር ቱርk itti gaafatamaa mirga namoomaa kan gamtaa mootummootaa ta'anii yeroo lammaffaaf akka filaman deeggarsa ishee ibsiteetti. Deeggarsi kun kan kenname biyyoonni akka Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Raashiyaan mormaa jiranittuu dha. Iiraan ቱርk waraana Gaazaa fi yeroon Raashiyaan Yukreen weerarte irratti yakka raawwatame balaaleffachuu isaaniin akka deeggartu ibsiteetti.

title: Mysterious deaths of 14 elephants in Kenya prompts urgent inquiry
english: Kenyan wildlife authorities have launched an investigation into the sudden deaths of 14 elephants found near Amboseli National Park. Experts are currently analyzing tissue samples from the animals to determine if the cause is disease, poisoning, or another factor. Because the victims include elephants of various ages and sexes across different locations, officials are treating the situation as a serious and unusual event.
amharic: የኬንያ የዱር እንስሳት ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት በአምቦሴሊ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ አቅራቢያ በድንገት የሞቱ 14 ዝሆኖችን አስመልክቶ ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። ባለሙያዎች የሞቱትን እንስሳት የሕክምና ናሙና በመውሰድ ሞታቸው በበሽታ፣ በመርዝ ወይም በሌላ ምክንያት መሆኑን ለማወቅ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ዝሆኖቹ በተለያዩ ዕድሜና ጾታ የተከፋፈሉ እና በተለያዩ ቦታዎች የተገኙ በመሆናቸው፣ ጉዳዩን አሳሳቢ እና ያልተለመደ ክስተት አድርገው እየተመለከቱት ነው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa bineensota bosonaa Keeniyaa, naannoo Paarkii Biyyoolessa Amboselitti argannee ijoollee arba 14 tasa du'an ilaalchisee qorannoo eegalaniiru. Ogeeyyonni foon fi qaama arboota du'anii fudhachuun duuti kun dhukkuba, summii ykn sababa biraatiin akka ta'e adda baasuuf tattaaffachaa jiru. Arboonni du'an kun umrii fi koorniyaa garaa garaa kan qaban fi bakka garaa garaatti kan argaman waan ta'eef, aangotni dhimma kana akka waan cimaa fi idilee hin taane tokkootti ilaalaa jiru.

title: Inside the secret battle to document RSF abuses in Sudan
english: A covert network of human rights monitors is risking their lives to record atrocities committed by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in Sudan's Darfur region. Using secure communication and mobile devices, these teams are gathering evidence of systematic violence, mass executions, and widespread sexual abuse. Their primary goal is to preserve this documentation to ensure that victims can eventually seek justice for these grave crimes.
amharic: በሱዳን የዳርፉር ክልል በሚንቀሳቀሱ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች፣ በራፒድ ሳፖርት ፎርሰስ (RSF) የሚፈጸሙ አሰቃቂ ጥቃቶችን በድብቅ የመመዝገብ ስራ እየተከናወነ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በከፍተኛ አደጋ ውስጥ ሆነው፣ ስልታዊ ግድያዎችን እና የጾታዊ ጥቃቶችን ማስረጃዎች በመሰብሰብ ላይ ይገኛሉ። የዚህ ጥረት ዋና አላማ ለወደፊት ተጎጂዎች ፍትህ እንዲገኝ ማስረጃዎችን በስርዓት ማቆየት ነው።
oromo: Godina Daarfuur kan Sudaan keessatti gareen mirga namoomaa iccitiidhaan socho'an humni 'Rapid Support Forces' (RSF) yakka raawwatu ragaa qabachaa jiru. Gareen kun balaa cimaa keessa ta'anii ajjeechaa sanyiin qindaa'eefi miidhaa saalqunnamtii irratti raawwatamu galmeessaa jiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan ragaa kana kuusuudhaan yeroo gara fuulduraatti miidhamtootni akka haqaa argatan gochuudha.

title: New Party: Why Turkiye’s opposition suffered a split and what that means
english: Former CHP leader Ozgur Ozel has launched a new political party alongside 90 lawmakers after a court ruling annulled his previous leadership. This split follows a period of legal pressure and investigations into opposition-led municipalities that have resulted in the detention of key figures like Istanbul's mayor. Ozel intends for this new movement to serve as a fresh alternative to challenge President Erdogan's long-standing AK Party.
amharic: የቀድሞው የCHP መሪ ኦዝጉር ኦዘል እና 90 የፓርላማ አባላት በአዲሱ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ አመራራቸው ከተሻረ በኋላ አዲስ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ መስርተዋል። ይህ መከፋፈል የተፈጠረው በአንጃው ላይ በደረሰው የህግ ጫና እና በከተማ አስተዳዳሪዎች ላይ በተከፈተው ምርመራ ምክንያት ነው። ኦዘል ይህ አዲስ ንቅናቄ የፕሬዚዳንት ኤርዶጋንን የAK ፓርቲ ለመቃወም የሚያስችል አማራጭ እንደሚሆን ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni duraanii CHP kan ta'an Ozgur Ozel fi miseensonni mana maree 90 ta'an, murtee mana murtii booda paartii siyaasaa haaraa hundeesseera. Gargar bahuun kun kan dhufe dhiibbaa seeraa fi qorannoo bulchiinsa mormituu irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee dha. Ozel paartiin haaraan kun filannoo kakuu kanaan duraan turee fi paartii Prezidaant Erdogaan akkasumas AK Party dura dhaabbachuuf carraa haaraa ta'a jedhee amana.

title: Tributes paid to Lindsey Graham at US Capitol ceremony
english: A memorial service was held at the United States Capitol to honor the late Republican Senator Lindsey Graham. Many officials and political leaders gathered in the Capitol Rotunda to pay their respects to his legacy. The ceremony featured a military honor guard carrying his casket to acknowledge his previous service in the armed forces.

oromo: Senatorii Ripabiliikaa kan turan Lindsey Graham yeroo boqotan sababeeffachuun, magaalaa Waashingitanitti sirni kabajaa kabajameef jira. Hoggantoonni fi qondaalonni mootummaa hedduun mana maree Kaapitolitti argamuun gumaacha inni biyya isaatiif godhe yaadatanii jiru. Sirnicharratti gareen waraanaa gumaacha inni yeroo tajaajila waraanaa godhe kabajuuf, reeffa isaa kabajaan baasuun sirnicha gaggeessaniiru.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 17
english: On the 17th day of the second phase of the conflict, President Donald Trump claims that negotiations with Iran have resumed and suggests that Tehran is eager for an agreement. Conversely, Iranian officials confirm that discussions are happening but maintain that they are not in a hurry to finalize a deal. Tensions remain high as Iran has also rejected a US proposal regarding frozen funds and issued warnings concerning navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: በግጭቱ ሁለተኛ ምዕራፍ አስራ ሰባተኛው ቀን፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ድርድር እንደገና መጀመሩን በመግለጽ ኢራን ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየለመነች እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ መሆናቸውን ያረጋገጡ ቢሆንም፣ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እንደማይቸኩሉ አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን በረዶ የሆኑ ገንዘቦቿን በሚመለከት የአሜሪካን እቅድ ውድቅ በማድረጓ እና በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ላይ ባወጣችው ማስጠንቀቂያ ውጥረቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Guyyaa 17ffaa waldhabdee kanaa irratti, pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp mariin Iran waliin ta'amuuf deebi'ee jalqabuu isaa fi Iran walii galtee tokkoof harka kennachaa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, aanga'oonni Iran mariin sun akka jiru mirkaneessanillee, walii galtee irratti gahuuf ariifannaa akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru. Iran qabeenya ishee kankarame ilaalchisee yaada Ameerikaa diduu fi dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz irratti akeekkachiisa kennuu isheen walqabatee rakkoon sun itti fufee jira.

title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy hails ‘good meeting’ with Trump at White House
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and US President Donald Trump held a productive meeting at the White House to discuss strengthening bilateral defense cooperation. The two leaders focused on plans for the joint production of Patriot missiles within Ukraine to improve the country's anti-aircraft defenses. Additionally, they reviewed diplomatic strategies aimed at ending the ongoing war and enhancing military technology partnerships.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር በዋይት ሀውስ ውጤታማ ውይይት አድርገዋል። መሪዎቹ በዩክሬን ውስጥ የፓትሪዮት ሚሳኤሎችን በጋራ በማምረት የአገሪቱን የአየር መከላከያ አቅም ለማሳደግ ተስማምተዋል። በተጨማሪም ጦርነቱን ለማስቆም ስለሚረዱ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች እና በወታደራዊ ቴክኖሎጂ ትብብር ላይ ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimiir Zeleniskii fi Pireezidaantiin Amerikaa Donaald Tiraamp waajjira adii keessatti marii bu'a qabeessa ta'e gaggeessaniiru. Hoggantoonni lamaan kun humna ittisa qilleensa biyyattii cimsuuf jecha biyyattii keessatti misaa'ela Paatriiyoooti waliin oomishuuf karoorfatan irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Kana malees, waraana itti fufee jiru xumuruuf tooftaa dippiloomaasii fi guddina teknoolojii waraanaa irratti mari'ataniiru.

title: Uefa reacts with fury to Infantino World Cup plan
english: UEFA has expressed strong opposition to FIFA's plan to seek private investment for its tournaments, including the World Cup. FIFA argues that this funding will help grow the game globally, but critics worry it could lead to personal financial gain for president Gianni Infantino. European football officials have criticized the move, stating that the World Cup is a public asset that should not be sold to private interests.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር (UEFA) የዓለም ዋንጫን ጨምሮ ለውድድሮቹ የግል ኢንቨስትመንት ለመፈለግ በፊፋ የተነደፈውን እቅድ አጥብቆ ተቃውሟል። ፊፋ ይህ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ስፖርቱን በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ለማሳደግ እንደሚረዳ ቢገልጽም፣ ተቺዎች ግን ለፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የግል ጥቅም ሊያስገኝ እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ አካላት የዓለም ዋንጫ የጋራ ንብረት እንጂ ለግል ኩባንያዎች የሚሸጥ አይደለም በማለት ውሳኔውን ተችተዋል።
oromo: UEFA hoggansi kubbaa miilaa Awurooppaa, FIFA dorgommiiwwan isaa keessumaa Waancaa Addunyaaf qabeenya dhuunfaa irraa maallaqa argachuuf karoorfate mormuun isaa beekameera. FIFA guddina ispoortichaa fiifi jedhee karooricha kan qopheesse yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu kun fayidaa dhuunfaa pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoof ooluu akka danda'u shakkii qabu. Hoggantoonni kubbaa miilaa Awurooppaa, Waancaan Addunyaa qabeenya ummataa waan ta'eef, namni kamiyyuu akka meeshaa daldalaatti fayyadamuu akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: Is Netanyahu’s Trump card losing its power in Israel?
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing questions about his once-strong political alliance with Donald Trump as their relationship shows signs of strain. The ongoing war with Iran has stalled, and Washington is increasingly willing to negotiate regional deals without prioritizing Israel's interests. With elections approaching in October, Netanyahu is visiting Washington to restore his image and prove he still maintains vital influence over the U.S. government.
amharic: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤኒያሚን ኔታንያሁ ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር የነበራቸው ጠንካራ የፖለቲካ ትስስር እየተዳከመ በመምጣቱ ተግዳሮቶች ተጋርጠውባቸዋል። ከኢራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ተገቶ መቆየቱ እና አሜሪካ የእስራኤልን ጥቅም ብቻ ሳይመለከት በራሷ መንገድ የክልሉን ጉዳዮች ለመፍታት መሞከሯ በኔታንያሁ ላይ ጫና ፈጥሯል። በጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ለማሳደርም ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ ላይ ያላቸው ተጽዕኖ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ ለማሳየት ወደ ዋሽንግተን ተጉዘዋል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Benyaamin Netanyaahuun hariiroo cimaa duraan Donald Traamp waliin qaban laafachaa dhufuun isaa gaaffii keessa galeera. Waxabajjii dhufu kanatti filannoon biyyattii waan ga'uuf, Netanyaahuun dhiibbaa isaan Ameerikaa irratti qaban akka hin dhumin namootatti agarsiisuuf gara Waashingitanitti imalaniiru.

title: Iran rejects Trump frozen funds plan, warns ships of Hormuz transit ban
english: Iran has officially dismissed Donald Trump's proposal to use frozen Iranian assets to pay for ships damaged in the Gulf. An official from the Revolutionary Guard cautioned that any vessel attempting to collect these funds will be prohibited from passing through the Strait of Hormuz. This stance creates further tension regarding the control of this vital maritime shipping lane.
amharic: ኢራን በባህረ ሰላጤው ለተጎዱ መርከቦች ካሳ ለመክፈል የቀዘቀዙ የኢራን ንብረቶችን ለመጠቀም የቀረበውን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሀሳብ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ የተባለውን ገንዘብ ለመቀበል የሚሞክር ማንኛውም መርከብ በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር እንዳያልፍ እንደሚከለከል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ አካሄድ በስትራቴጂያዊ የባህር መስመር ላይ ያለውን ውጥረት የበለጠ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Iiraan yaada Donald Trump kan qabeenya Iiraan itti gaafatamummaa meeshaalee laga Gacana keessatti miidhamaniif kaffaluuf itti fayyadamuu barbaadu mormiteetti. Humni eegumsa naannoo Iiraan (IRGC) akka ibsetti, namni ykn dooniin kamiyyuu qarshii kana fudhachuuf yaalu kamiyyuu daandii galaana Hormuz keessa akka hin darbine dhowwameera. Gochi kun daandii daldala galaana idil-addunyaa kana irratti dhiibbaa fi walitti bu'iinsa uumuu danda'a.

title: Trump expresses frustration with Netanyahu before White House meeting
english: President Trump expressed irritation toward Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shortly before their White House meeting, criticizing him for publicly discussing sensitive intelligence regarding Iran. Trump dismissed the claims about Iran's nuclear site and suggested the Prime Minister is trying to pressure him into maintaining military involvement. This tension follows their joint participation in a conflict with Iran and differing views on diplomatic efforts to resolve the situation.

oromo: Pirezedaant Traamp walgahii Waayit Haawsitti erga taa'aniin dura, Ministira Muummee Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu odeeffannoo dhokataa waa'ee Iraan yeroo baasaniif komataniiru. Walitti buutiin kunis waraana Iraan irratti waliin jalqabanii fi karaa furmaata dippilomaasii irratti garaagarummaan isaanii akka jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: German investigators find apparent motive after Berlin Pride attack
english: German authorities have linked a deadly attack at a Berlin Pride event to the ISIL extremist group after discovering a video of the suspect pledging allegiance to the organization. The 21-year-old attacker, who was shot by police after killing one woman and injuring many others, had a prior history of legal trouble related to extremist activities. Investigators recovered evidence on the suspect's phone and at his residence confirming his radical connections.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በበርሊን በተካሄደው የኩራት በዓል ላይ የደረሰውን ገዳይ ጥቃት ከአይሲኤስ (ISIL) አሸባሪ ቡድን ጋር አያይዘውታል። ይህም የተጠረጠረው ግለሰብ ታማኝነቱን ለቡድኑ ሲገልጽ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በስልኩ በመገኘቱ ነው። በአንድ ሴት ህልፈት እና በብዙዎች ላይ ጉዳት ካደረሰ በኋላ በፖሊስ የተገደለው ወጣት፣ ከዚህ ቀደም በአክራሪነት ድርጊቶች ሳቢያ በህግ መያዙ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Jarmanii miidhaa cimaa ayyaana 'Berlin Pride' irratti gahe garee ISIL waliin wal qabsiisaniiru; kunis shakkiin kun amanamummaa isaa garee kanaaf ibsuu isaa viidiyoo bilbila isaa irraa argameen mirkanaa'eera. Namni umrii 21 fi du'a dubartii tokkoo akkasumas miiidhaa namoota hedduu irratti erga gahe booda poolisiin ajjeefame kun, kanaan dura gocha garee amantii hamaa waliin wal qabatuun seeraan gaafatamaa ture.

title: FIFA World Cup: For India, qualification is still just a distant dream
english: India remains far from participating in the FIFA World Cup due to systemic failures, poor youth development, and organizational instability within its football federation. Despite its large population, the country is ranked 138th globally and recently failed to qualify for the 2027 Asian Cup. Experts suggest that reforming the sport will require decades of work to overcome these deep-seated structural challenges.
amharic: በህንድ እግር ኳስ ማህበር ውስጥ ባሉ የአደረጃጀት ችግሮች፣ ደካማ የወጣቶች ስፖርት ልማት እና የስርዓት መዛባት ምክንያት ህንድ በፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ለመሳተፍ አሁንም በጣም የራቀች ናት። ምንም እንኳን ህንድ እጅግ ሰፊ ህዝብ ቢኖራትም፣ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በ138ኛ ደረጃ ላይ የምትገኝ ሲሆን በቅርቡም ለ2027 የእስያ ዋንጫ ማለፍ ተስኗታል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት የሀገሪቱን እግር ኳስ ወደ ተሻለ ደረጃ ለማድረስ እና መሰረታዊ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት የበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ስራ ያስፈልጋል።
oromo: Indiyaan rakkoo sirnaa, misooma dargaggootaa dadhabaa fi giddugaleessa kubbaa miillaa ishee keessatti rakkoo jiru irraa kan ka'e, hirmaannaa Waancaa Addunyaa FIFA irratti argachuun ishee ammallee kan fagaate dha. Biyyattii uummata baay'ee qabdu ta'us, sadarkaa addunyaatti 138ffaa irratti kan argamtu yoo ta'u, dhiheenya kana Waancaa Eeshiyaa bara 2027 qulqullaa'uun ishee dadhabameera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, kubbaa miillaa biyyattii fooyyessuufi rakkoolee gadi fagoofii jiran kana furuuf waggoota hedduu kan fudhatu carraaqqii cimaa barbaada.

title: Exclusive: Does the UK's 'don't talk to the Muslim Council of Britain' policy actually exist?
english: The British government continues to avoid working with the Muslim Council of Britain (MCB), claiming it follows a long-standing non-engagement policy. However, investigative analysis suggests this policy may not officially exist, as government departments have no written documentation or clear justification for the boycott. This confusion arises as the government aims to repair its relationship with the Muslim community amid increasing reports of attacks on mosques.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት ከብሪታንያ ሙስሊሞች ምክር ቤት (MCB) ጋር ላለመስራት የቀድሞ መንግስታት የነበራቸውን ፖሊሲ እንደተከተለ ይገልጻል። ነገር ግን፣ ይህንን መመሪያ የሚያረጋግጥ ምንም አይነት የተፃፈ ሰነድ ወይም በቂ ምክንያት ባለመገኘቱ ፖሊሲው ምናልባትም በይፋ ያልነበረ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጥናቶች ያሳያሉ። በሙስሊም ማህበረሰብ ላይ የሚደርሱ ጥቃቶች እየጨመሩ ባለበት ወቅት፣ መንግስት ከሙስሊም ማህበረሰብ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማሻሻል እየሞከረ መሆኑም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritishii akkaataa heera mootummoota darban hordofuun mana maree Muslimoota Biritishii (MCB) wajjin hojjechuu akka hin barbaanne ibseera. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, seera ykn qajeelfama kana kan mirkaneessu ragaan barreeffamaa tokkollee hin jiru. Yeroo ammaa, miidhaan masjiidota irratti qaqqabu dabalaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan ummata Muslimaa wajjin hariiroo isaa fooyyessuuf yaalaa jira.

title: Israeli forces demolish eleven homes in occupied West Bank during past 24 hours
english: Israeli forces recently destroyed eleven Palestinian homes in the occupied West Bank within a single day. Beyond the demolitions, authorities seized land for military use and began expanding settlement infrastructure near Tubas. Additionally, reports indicate that settlers attacked local residents while security forces carried out multiple arrests.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ አስራ አንድ የፍልስጤም ቤቶችን አፍርሰዋል። ከዚህ ድርጊት በተጨማሪ ባለስልጣናቱ ለወታደራዊ አገልግሎት የሚውል መሬትን በቁጥጥራቸው ስር አውለዋል እንዲሁም አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት የሚያስችሉ ተግባራትን ጀምረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙና በርካታ ሰዎች መታሰራቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el guyyoota darban keessa lafa daangaa dhihaa keessatti manneen warra Falastiinii kudha tokko diiganiiru. Diiggaa manneenii kana cinatti, mootummaan lafa qonnaan bultootaa waraanaf fayyadamuuf kan fudhate yoo ta'u, babal'ina bu'uuraalee misoomaa naannoo Tubasitti jalqabeera. Kana malees, qe'ee isaanii irratti namoota irratti haleellaan raawwatamuu fi namoonni hedduun hidhamuun gabaasameera.

title: Exclusive: Does the UK's 'don't talk to the Muslim Council of Britain' policy actually exist?
english: The new UK government under Andy Burnham claims to maintain a policy of not engaging with the Muslim Council of Britain (MCB). However, investigations reveal that there are no official written records or clear departmental origins for this boycott. Despite the government's stance, the lack of transparency raises questions about whether this policy exists in any formal capacity.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ አዲሱ መንግስት ከአንዲ በርንሃም መሪነት ጋር በብሪታንያ ሙስሊም ካውንስል (MCB) ላይ ያለው የግንኙነት እገዳ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይሁን እንጂ የተደረጉ ምርመራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ይህ እገዳ በጽሁፍ የተመዘገበ ህጋዊ ሰነድ የለውም። መንግስት ይህንን ፖሊሲ ተግባራዊ እያደረገ ቢሆንም፣ በይፋ የሚታወቅ የመንግስት ሰነድ ባለመገኘቱ ጉዳዩ ግራ አጋቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Mootummaan UK kan haaraan Andy Burnham geggeeffamu, waldaan Muslimoota Britaan (MCB) waliin hidhata akka hin qabanne ibseera. Mootummaan dhorkaa kana itti fufuun isaa himamees, ragaan seera qabeessa ta'e tokkollee waan hin jirreef, dhimmichi shakkiin akka itti uumame ta'eera.

title: At least 22 Palestinians wounded in Israeli attacks on Gaza
english: Israeli military operations across the Gaza Strip on Tuesday resulted in at least 22 injuries among the local population. Attacks targeted various locations, including a school, a market in a refugee camp, and residential areas. Medical organizations and local sources confirmed that these incidents occurred in several different neighborhoods throughout the region.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች የጋዛ ሰርጥ ውስጥ ቢያንስ 22 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ ትምህርት ቤትን፣ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ገበያን እና የተለያዩ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎችን ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። የህክምና ተቋማት እና የአካባቢው ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ጉዳቶቹ በተለያዩ የጋዛ ክፍሎች የተከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxataa weerara waraana Israa'el kan Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffameen namoonni 22 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Weerara kana keessatti manneen barnootaa, gabaa keessatti bakka godaantonni qubatanii jiran, fi naannolee jireenyaa kanneen biroo rukutamaniiru. Maddoonni oduu fi dhaabbileen fayyaa akka gabaasanitti, miidhaan kun naannolee adda addaa Gaazaa keessatti kan qaqqabe ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Netanyahu arrives at the White House
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has reached the White House to hold private discussions with President Donald Trump. This encounter marks their first formal meeting since the start of the ongoing military conflict between Israel and Iran on February 28. The two leaders are expected to coordinate their strategies regarding the situation.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር በዋይት ሀውስ በግል ለመነጋገር ተገናኝተዋል። ይህ ስብሰባ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል የካቲት 28 ከተጀመረው ግጭት በኋላ የሁለቱ መሪዎች የመጀመሪያ ግንኙነት ነው። መሪዎቹ በወቅታዊ ጉዳዮች ዙሪያ ምክክር እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benyaamiin Neetanyaahuu pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp waliin marii dhimmoota iddoo cufaa ta'e irratti hirmaachuuf gara Waayit Haawus gahuun isaanii himameera. Kunis, waraanni Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti Guraandhalaa 28 eegale erga jalqabee booda mariin gaggeeffamu isa jalqabaati. Hoggantoonni lamaan haala jiru irratti marii akka taasisan eegama.

title: Gironde wildfires pick up as French region braces for new 40C heatwave
english: Firefighters in France are struggling to contain intense wildfires in the Gironde region as they prepare for another severe heatwave with temperatures reaching 40C. While the city of Bordeaux is not immediately threatened, officials remain concerned about the fire's proximity and the resulting poor air quality. Residents and tourists are experiencing smoky conditions and significant disruptions to daily life as emergency teams work around the clock to manage the crisis.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የጂሮንድ ክልል የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ባለመቆጣጠሩ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አዳጋች ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የሙቀት መጠኑ ወደ 40 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ የሚደርስ ሌላ የሙቀት ማዕበል በመምጣቱ ሁኔታውን የበለጠ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። የቦርዶ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች እና ጎብኚዎች በጢስ እና በአመድ የተበከለ አየር እየተቸገሩ ሲሆን፣ የከተማዋ እንቅስቃሴም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Naannoo Jiirondii kan Faransaay keessatti ibidda cimaa ka'e to'achuuf gargaartonni ibiddaa halkanii fi guyyaa carraaqaa jiru, garuu qilleensi baay'ee ho'uun hanga 40C gahuuf jedhu haalicha caalaatti ulfeessaa jira. Magaalaan Boordoo battalumatti balaa keessa kan hin jirre ta'us, aaraan faalamee jiraachuu isaatiin jiraattonni fi turistoonni rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf hamma danda'ametti carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Mancini reappointed Italy boss after Pirlo controversy
english: Roberto Mancini has returned as the head coach of the Italian national football team following the resignation of the previous leadership. His appointment follows the withdrawal of Andrea Pirlo from consideration due to a controversy involving his ties to a betting company. Additionally, Claudio Ranieri has been named the new technical director to replace Paolo Maldini, who stepped down amid the organizational turmoil.

oromo: Roberto Mancini hogganoota duraanii hojii gad-lakkisuu isaanii hordofee leenjisaa garee kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa Xaaliyaanii ta'ee deebi'eera. Muudamni isaa kan ta'e, Andrea Pirlo walitti dhufeenya inni dhaabbata bettii wajjin qabu irratti falmii uumameen booda of duuba erga jedhee booda. Kana malees, Claudio Ranieri bakka Paolo Maldini kan hojii gad-lakkisee dirqama daayireektara teeknikaa haaraa ta'ee fudhateera.

title: Iraqi PM visits Turkiye to boost ties despite complex challenges
english: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi is leading a high-level delegation to Turkiye to strengthen bilateral ties and address critical issues including security, water resources, and economic cooperation. A primary goal of the visit is to negotiate a new oil export agreement, as Iraq seeks alternative routes for its crude shipments amid ongoing regional instability. Both nations aim to enhance their strategic partnership despite complex technical and financial disagreements regarding pipeline terms.
amharic: የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ አል-ዛይዲ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እና የደህንነት፣ የውሃ ሀብት እንዲሁም የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳዮችን ለመወያየት ከፍተኛ የልዑካን ቡድን ይዘው ቱርክ ገብተዋል። የጉብኝቱ ዋና ትኩረት በአካባቢው እየተፈጠረ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት ተከትሎ ኢራቅ አማራጭ የነዳጅ መላኪያ መስመሮችን ለመፈለግ እና አዲስ የነዳጅ ንግድ ስምምነት ለመፈራረም ነው። ሁለቱም ሀገራት በቧንቧ መስመር አጠቃቀም ላይ አንዳንድ አለመግባባቶች ቢኖሩም ስልታዊ ትብብራቸውን ለማሳደግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Iraaq Alii Al-Zayidii fi gareen isaa hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuuf akkasumas dhimmoota nageenyaa, qabeenya bishaanii fi dinagdee irratti mari'achuuf gara Turkii imalaniiru. Hojiiwwan gurguddoo imala kanaa keessaa inni ijoon, rakkoolee naannichaa jiran furuuf akkasumas boba'aa gara gabaa addunyaatti erguuf karaa haaraa mijeeffachuu fi waliigaltee boba'aa haaraa mallatteessuudha. Biyyoonni lamaan dhimmoota teeknikaa fi kaffaltii jiran irratti walii galtee dhabanis, waliin hojjechuuf fedhii qabu.

title: France and Spain brace for heatwave that could worsen raging wildfires
english: France and Spain are facing a new intense heatwave that threatens to worsen ongoing, destructive wildfires in both nations. While some progress has been made in controlling the blazes, officials are concerned that temperatures reaching 40 degrees Celsius will trigger further fire outbreaks. Massive evacuations have taken place in both countries, with authorities implementing strict bans on public events to ensure safety during this climate crisis.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን በሁለቱም ሀገራት እየተስፋፋ ያለውን አውዳሚ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ሊያባብስ የሚችል አዲስ ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እየተጋፈጡ ነው። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ስራዎች አንዳንድ መሻሻሎችን ቢያሳዩም፣ የሙቀት መጠኑ ወደ 40 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ ሊደርስ እንደሚችል በመጠቆሙ ባለስልጣናት ስጋት ገብቷቸዋል። በአየር ንብረት ቀውሱ ምክንያት በሁለቱም ሀገራት በርካታ ሰዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ የህዝብ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅም ጥብቅ ክልከላዎች ተጥለዋል።
oromo: Faransaayifi Ispeen, ibidda bosonaa biyyoota lamaanuu keessatti hammaataa jiru kana caalaatti hammeessuu danda'u jedhamee sodaatame, holqa hoo'a cimaa isa haaraa tokko keessa jiru. Tattaaffiin ibidicha to'achuuf godhamaa jiru tokko tokko bu'aa argamsiisaa jiraatus, ho'inni hanga digrii 40 seelsiyesii gahuun ibidda kana ammas hammeessuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama. Balaa kana irraa lubbuu oolchuuf namoonni hedduun bakka jireenyaa isaanii gadhiisanii baqachaa jiru, akkasumas mootummoonni nageenya ummataa eeguuf jecha dhorkaa jabaa keessatti argamu.

title: Roberto Mancini to be named Italy head coach for second time, source says
english: Roberto Mancini has been reappointed as the head coach of the Italian national football team, replacing Gennaro Gattuso following the team's failure to qualify for the World Cup. He will be joined by Claudio Ranieri, who takes over as the new technical director. This leadership change follows a series of unsuccessful attempts to secure other candidates for the national side.
amharic: ሮቤርቶ ማንቺኒ የጣሊያን ብሄራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ዳግም መሾማቸውን የጣሊያን እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን አስታውቋል። ቡድኑ ለዓለም ዋንጫ ማለፍ ባለመቻሉ ከኃላፊነታቸው በተነሱት ጄናሮ ጋቱሶ ምትክ ነው ማንቺኒ የተተኩት። በተጨማሪም ክላውዲዮ ራኔሪ የቴክኒክ ዳይሬክተር በመሆን አዲሱን የቡድን አመራር ይቀላቀላሉ።
oromo: Roobertoo Maanchiniin leenjisaa garee kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa Xaaliyaanii ta'uun lammaffaaf muudamaniiru. Kana malees, Klaawudiyoo Raaneeriin daayirektara teekinikaa ta'uun hojiin kanatti makamaniiru.

title: Israeli soldier runs marathon around Gaza outpost
english: An Israeli soldier recorded himself completing a marathon near a military base in Gaza to signal a permanent military presence. This action highlights the ongoing conflict and stands in direct contrast to the struggles of Palestinians, whose daily lives are severely restricted by war and displacement. The footage has drawn attention to the starkly different experiences of those living under military occupation versus those enforcing it.

oromo: Loltuun Israa'el tokko buufata waraanaa Gaazaa keessatti argamu tokko marsuudhaan maaraatoonii fiigee fi hidhattoonni isaanii iddoo sanaa akka hin deemne ibseera. Gochi kun jireenya waraanaa fi buqqaatiin miidhaman kanneen jiraattota Falasxiim wajjiin wal bira qabamee yoo ilaalamu addaddummaa guddaa qaba. Fiigichi kun namoota waraanaan miidhamanii fi kanneen waraana geggeessan gidduutti garaagarummaa jiru ifa godha.

title: Tate brothers face at least two more weeks in US jail as bail bid reviewed
english: Influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate will remain in a Miami federal jail for at least another two weeks while they fight extradition to the UK. They are facing 59 serious criminal charges, including rape and sex trafficking. Their legal team is seeking bail, claiming the brothers face significant safety threats while in custody, despite the brothers' history of flaunting a luxurious lifestyle.
amharic: አንድሪው እና ትሪስታን ታቴ ወደ እንግሊዝ የመወሰድ ክሳቸውን በመቃወም ላይ ሳሉ ቢያንስ ለሚቀጥሉት ሁለት ሳምንታት በሚያሚ በሚገኝ የፌደራል እስር ቤት እንዲቆዩ ተወስኗል። ወንድማማቾቹ አስገድዶ መድፈር እና ሰዎችን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ለወሲብ ንግድ ማዘዋወርን ጨምሮ 59 ከባድ የወንጀል ክሶች ቀርበውባቸዋል። የህግ ባለሙያዎቻቸው በቁጥጥር ስር ባሉበት ጊዜ ለደህንነታቸው ስጋት እንዳለ በመግለጽ በዋስ እንዲፈቱ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።

Obboleewwan kun yakka gudeeddii fi daldala saala dabalatee himannaa yakka 59 irratti dhihaatee jira. Gareen abukaattoota isaanii, hidhaa keessatti jireenyi isaanii balaadhaaf saaxilameera jechuun baasii isaanii akka eeyyamamuuf gaaffii dhiheessaa jiru.

title: War on Iran: What is Tehran's 'shadow fleet' really and how does it work?
english: Following the collapse of peace negotiations and a new naval blockade, Iran continues to export oil using a 'shadow fleet' of aging tankers to bypass US sanctions. These ships avoid detection by disabling tracking devices, utilizing ship-to-ship transfers, and registering under flags of convenience to hide their true ownership. While the US attempts to isolate Iran economically, this clandestine network remains a vital source of revenue by moving oil to willing buyers despite global restrictions.
amharic: የሰላም ድርድሩ በመፍረሱ እና አዲስ የባህር ላይ እገዳ በመጣሉ፣ ኢራን በአሜሪካ ማዕቀቦች የተከለከለውን ነዳጅ ለመሸጥ 'ጥላ መርከቦች' በመባል የሚታወቁ የቆዩ መርከቦችን እየተጠቀመች ነው። እነዚህ መርከቦች የክትትል መረጃቸውን በማጥፋት፣ ነዳጁን በባህር ላይ ወደ ሌላ መርከብ በማዛወር እና የባለቤትነት መብታቸውን በመደበቅ ከራዳር ውጭ ይንቀሳቀሳሉ። አሜሪካ ኢራንን በኢኮኖሚ ለመገደብ ብትሞክርም፣ ይህ ህገ-ወጥ የሚመስል የንግድ መረብ ሀገሪቱ ገቢ እንድታገኝ እያደረጋት ይገኛል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan nageenyaa erga fashaleen booda fi dhiibbaan galaana irraa erga irra kaa'ameen booda, Iraan sanada Ameerikaa jalaa miliquuf 'dooniiwwan dhokataa' (shadow fleet) fayyadamtee boba'aa gurgurachuu itti fufteetti. Dooniiwwan kun iddoo jiran beeksisuu dhiisuu, boba'aa karaa galaanaa doonii tokko irraa gara kaaniitti dabarsuu fi eenyummaa isaanii dhoksuudhaan to'annoo jalaa bahu. Ameerikaan Iraan gargar baasuuf yaaltus, hojiin dhokataa kun biyyattiin daldala boba'aa irraa galii akka argattuuf carraa uumaafii jira.

title: Iran threatens Hormuz ban on countries accepting frozen assets under Trump plan
english: Iran has threatened to block access to the Strait of Hormuz for any nation or business that accepts Iranian funds seized by the United States. This warning follows a proposal by President Donald Trump to use frozen Iranian assets to compensate for damages occurring in the shipping lane. Tehran has officially rejected the U.S. plan, labeling it an illegal and provocative measure.

oromo: Iiraan biyyoota ykn dhaabbata mootummaan Ameerikaa qabeenya Iiraan itti hidhe fayyadamee kaffaltii fudhataniif, daandii galaana Hormuz akka cufu akeekkachiisteerti.
