Teheran yaada Ameerikaa kana kan mormite yoo ta'u, gocha seeraan alaa fi kan kakaasudha jechuun ibsiteerti.

title: Inside Turkey's plan for world's largest startup hub at Ataturk Airport
english: Turkish officials are transforming the decommissioned Ataturk Airport in Istanbul into 'Terminal Istanbul,' an expansive hub designed to be the world's largest center for startups and entrepreneurs. The project converts old terminal buildings into modern offices and incubation spaces to attract international investors and help local businesses reach global markets. Key partnerships, including with the global accelerator Techstars and Chinese investment funds, have already been established to support this innovative ecosystem.
amharic: የቱርክ መንግስት አገልግሎት መስጠት ያቆመውን የአታቱርክ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ 'ተርሚናል ኢስታንቡል' ወደሚባል ግዙፍ የቴክኖሎጂ እና የስታርት-አፕ ማዕከል እየቀየረው ነው። ፕሮጀክቱ የቀድሞውን ተርሚናል ዘመናዊ የቢሮ ቦታዎች እና የአዳዲስ ፈጠራዎች መፈልፈያ በማድረግ ለአለም አቀፍ ባለሀብቶች ምቹ ሁኔታን ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው። ከቴክስታርስ እና ከቻይና የኢንቨስትመንት ተቋማት ጋር በተደረጉ ስምምነቶች አማካኝነት፣ ይህ ማዕከል አዳዲስ የንግድ ስራዎችን ወደ አለም አቀፍ ገበያ ለማሸጋገር ታቅዷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Turkii buufata xiyyaraa Ataturk kan duraanii 'Terminal Istanbul' gara giddugaleessa teeknoolojii fi stooart-aappii addunyaa irratti isa guddaa ta'utti jijjiiraa jira. Projeektichi gamoo duraanii sanatti fayyadamuun bakka hojii ammayyaa fi giddugaleessa haarawa uumuu danda'u ijaaruun, invastaraa fi abbootii qabeenyaa addunyaa irraa dhufan hawwachuuf karoorfameera. Walitti dhufeenya 'Techstars' fi dhaabbilee invastimantii Chaayinaa wajjin uumameen, giddugaleessi kun oomishtoota haarawaa fi dhaabbilee xixiqqoo gara gabaa addunyaatti ce'uuf gargaara.

title: Oman proposes joint control of Strait of Hormuz as mediators expect talks 'breakthrough'
english: Oman has proposed that regional nations jointly manage the Strait of Hormuz to ensure safe passage and environmental protection, similar to the model used in the Strait of Malacca. This initiative is being discussed as a potential breakthrough to resolve ongoing tensions and conflict between the United States and Iran. Mediators are hopeful that upcoming high-level discussions between President Trump and Prime Minister Netanyahu will lead to a diplomatic resolution for the waterway.
amharic: ኦማን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ደህንነት እና የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ለማረጋገጥ ቀጠናዊ ሀገራት በጋራ እንዲያስተዳድሩ ሀሳብ አቅርባለች። ይህ የመፍትሄ ሃሳብ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ግጭት ለመፍታት እንደ ትልቅ መነሻ ተወስዷል። የሰላም አስታራቂዎች በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እና በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኔታንያሁ መካከል የሚደረገው ውይይት ለችግሩ ዘላቂ መፍትሄ እንደሚገኝ ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Omaan daandiin bishanii Hormuz nageenya isaa eeguufi miidhaa naannoo irraa ittisuuf, biyyoonni naannichaa waliin ta’uun akka bulchan yaada dhiyeessiteetti. Yaadni kun walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu jiru furuuf furmaata cimaa ta’a jedhamee eegama. Giddugaleeyyiin nageenyaa marii biyyoolessaa Trumpifi Netanyaahu gidduutti godhamuun furmaata dippilomaasii akka argamu abdii qabu.

title: Saudi Aramco closes Jazan refinery after Houthi attack
english: Saudi Aramco has temporarily suspended operations at the Jazan refinery following a Houthi attack that damaged storage and gasification infrastructure. The facility, which has a daily capacity of 400,000 barrels, is expected to remain closed for repairs until mid-August. This strike is part of an ongoing conflict that is increasingly threatening energy production and global supply chains.
amharic: በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰበት የሳዑዲ አራምኮ የጃዛን ነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ስራውን በጊዜያዊነት ማቆሙን አስታውቋል። በቀን 400,000 በርሜል ዘይት የማጣራት አቅም ያለው ይህ ማጣሪያ፣ ጥገና ተደርጎለት እስከ ነሐሴ አጋማሽ ድረስ ስራውን ለመጀመር ታቅዷል። ይህ ጥቃት በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት ከማባባሱም በላይ በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humni Houthii buufata baattarii boba'aa Jazan irratti haleellaa raawwateen wal qabatee, dhaabbanni Sa'udii Aramco hojii isaa yeroof dhaabeera. Buufatni kun guyyaatti boba'aa baarmila 400,000 kan oomishu yoo ta'u, suphaa barbaachisu erga godhamee booda hamma guyyaa 15 Hagayyaatti hojii jalqabuuf karoorfameera. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa hammeessuu fi dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa ibsameera.

title: Zelensky to press Trump on air defences while in Washington
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is visiting Washington to meet with Donald Trump, focusing on securing essential air defense systems for Ukraine. He is specifically pushing for permission to manufacture Patriot interceptor missiles domestically to counter increased Russian ballistic missile strikes. The two leaders are also in the U.S. to attend Senator Lindsey Graham’s funeral while navigating complex geopolitical tensions involving Russia, Iran, and the Middle East.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ለዩክሬን ወሳኝ የሆኑ የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎችን ለማግኘት ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ለመነጋገር ዋሽንግተን ገብተዋል። ዘሌንስኪ በሀገራቸው ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የሩሲያ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ለመከላከል የፓትሪያት ሚሳይሎችን በዩክሬን ውስጥ በጋራ ለማምረት የሚያስችል ፈቃድ ለማግኘት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በዋሽንግተን የተገኙት ሴናተር ሊንዚ ግራሃም የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ለመታደም ሲሆን፣ በተመሳሳይ ወቅት በሩሲያ፣ ኢራን እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ውይይት ይደረግበታል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimiir Zeleeniski meeshaalee ittisa qilleensaa biyya isaaniif barbaachisaa ta'an argachuuf gara Waashington imalanii Donald Traamp waliin mari'achaa jiru. Zeleeniski haleellaa mizaayilii Raashiyaa biyya isaanii irratti geggeessaa jirtu dhaabuuf, mizaayilii Paatriyaat biyya keessatti oomishuuf hayyama argachuu barbaadu. Hoggantoonni lamaan kun Waashington kan argaman awwaala Senetar Lindii Giraaham irratti hirmaachuuf yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin walitti dhufeenya biyyoota garagaraa fi rakkoolee geopolitikii isaan mudate irratti mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Seattle pays tribute to food festival shooting victims
english: Seattle residents held a vigil to mourn the three individuals killed during a violent shootout at the Bite of Seattle food festival. The victims included two innocent bystanders and one person police believe was involved in the altercation. City officials have strongly condemned the violence, while community members are providing significant financial support to the families of those who lost their lives.
amharic: የሲያትል ነዋሪዎች በከተማዋ በተደረገው የምግብ ፌስቲቫል ላይ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ህይወታቸው ላለፈ ሶስት ሰዎች መታሰቢያ ስነ-ስርዓት አድርገዋል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል ሁለቱ ንፁሃን ሲሆኑ አንዱ ተጠርጣሪ እንደሆነ ፖሊስ ገልጿል። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር ጥቃቱን በጽኑ ያወገዘ ሲሆን ህብረተሰቡም ለሟች ቤተሰቦች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Namoonni magaalaa Siyaatil, ayyaana nyaataa irratti dhukaasa ka'een lubbuun isaanii darbe sadiif yaadannoo godhaniiru. Miidhamtoota keessaa lammiin isaanii kan yakka irratti hirmaatan, lama immoo namoota nagaa ta'uu poolisiin ibseera. Bulchiinsi magaalattii gocha kana balaaleffachuun, hawaasnis maatii lubbuun isaanii darbeef gargaarsa maallaqaa taasiisaa jiru.

title: Fatal Shooting in ICE Operations
english: The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency is facing significant criticism following the deaths of two individuals in separate shooting incidents. Although the agency has received increased funding and expanded its staff under President Trump’s mass deportation strategy, concerns are growing regarding insufficient agent training and vetting. Critics argue that these fatal incidents, which involved people who were not the intended targets, highlight a troubling lack of oversight in the current crackdown on undocumented migrants.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ አስከባሪ ኤጀንሲ (ICE) በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በደረሱ ሁለት ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጦች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ወቀሳ እየቀረበበት ይገኛል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በጀመሩት የጅምላ ስደተኞችን የማባረር ዘመቻ ኤጀንሲው ከፍተኛ በጀት እና ተጨማሪ የሰው ኃይል የተመደበለት ቢሆንም፣ የሰራተኞቻቸው ስልጠና እና መመልመያ ሂደት ላይ ትልቅ ጥያቄ ተነስቷል። በተለይም የታለመላቸው ግለሰቦች ያልሆኑ ንጹሃን ሰለባ መሆናቸው፣ በኤጀንሲው አሰራር ላይ የክትትል እና የቁጥጥር ክፍተት መኖሩን አስገንዝቧል።
oromo: Ejensiin kabachiisa seeraa kan godaantotaa fi gumuruka Ameerikaa (ICE) namoota lama ajjeefamuu isaanii hordofee qeeqaa cimaaf saaxilamee jira. Erga pirezidanti Tiraamp sagantaa baqattoota biyyattiin baasuuf karoorsanii booda, ejensichi qarshii fi hojjettoota dabalataa argatee jiraatus, leenjii fi qulqullina hojjettoota isaanii irratti komiin guddaan ka’ee jira. Ajjeechaawwan kunneen kan raawwataman namoota hin taane irratti waan ta’eef, ejensichi hojii isaa irratti to’annoo gahaa hin qabu jedhamee himatamaa jira.

title: Tate’s attorney says allegations ‘puts a target on their backs’
english: Andrew and Tristan Tate were recently arrested in the United States following new accusations from British authorities. These serious charges include allegations of rape and human trafficking. Their legal counsel expressed deep concern that these specific claims could make the brothers primary targets for violence while they are incarcerated.
amharic: አንድሪው እና ትሪስታን ታቴ በብሪታኒያ ባለስልጣናት የቀረቡባቸውን አዳዲስ ክሶች ተከትሎ በአሜሪካ ታስረዋል። ወንድማማቾቹ በግፍ ድርጊት እና በሰዎች ዝውውር ወንጀል የተከሰሱ ሲሆን፣ ጠበቃቸውም በእነዚህ ክሶች ምክንያት በእስር ቤት ውስጥ ለጥቃት የመጋለጥ እድላቸው ሰፊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Andiruu fi Tiriistaan Teet himannaa haaraa mootummaa Biritaaniyaatiin walqabatee Ameerikaatti hidhamaniiru. Obboleeyyan kun yakka gudeeddii fi nama daldaluun himatamaa jiru. Abukaaton isaanii himannaan kun hidha keessatti lubbuun isaanii balaaf akka saaxilamu gochuu danda'a jedhee yaadda'eera.

title: Authorities open fire amid election unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
english: Violent clashes have broken out in Pakistan-administered Kashmir as protests and road blockades intensified. Demonstrators are calling for significant political reforms, specifically targeting the removal of controversial assembly seats before upcoming legislative elections. Security forces responded to the unrest by opening fire, leading to a dangerous escalation in the region.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር ለሳምንታት የዘለቀው ተቃውሞ ወደ ሁከት ተቀይሯል። ተቃዋሚዎች ከምርጫው በፊት የፖለቲካ ማሻሻያዎችን እና አወዛጋቢ የሆኑ የፓርላማ መቀመጫዎች እንዲሰረዙ እየጠየቁ ነው። የጸጥታ ሃይሎች ተቃውሞውን ለመቆጣጠር በወሰዱት እርምጃ ጥይት በመተኮሳቸው ግጭቱ ተባብሷል።
oromo: Naannoo Kaashmir kan Paakistaani bulchitu keessatti, mormii fi daandii cufuun walqabatee walitti buutiin cimaan uumameera. Hiriirtonni filannoo dhiyaate kana dura jijjiirama siyaasaa barbaaduu fi teessoon aadaa (assembly seats) mormii kaase haa haqamu gaafachaa jiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa mormii kana dhaabsisuuf dhukaasa banuun isaanii naannichatti haala sodaachisaa uumeera.

title: Israeli settler attack on at-Tuwani
english: Armed Israeli settlers recently launched a violent nighttime raid on the village of at-Tuwani in the occupied West Bank. During the attack, the intruders set fire to local homes and a mosque, forcing families to flee for their safety. This incident occurs amid a significant and record-breaking increase in settler violence within the region.
amharic: ታጣቂ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በቅርቡ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አቱዋኒ መንደር ላይ በሌሊት ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎም ወራሪዎቹ የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ቤቶች እና መስጊድ በእሳት አቃጥለዋል፤ ይህም ቤተሰቦች ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲሸሹ አስገድዷቸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ ውስጥ የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እየጨመረ ባለበት ወቅት የተፈጠረ ነው።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el meeshaa waraanaatiin hidhatan tokko dhiheenya kana baankii dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti, ganda at-Tuwani jedhamu irratti halkan sa'atii gadhee haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan manneen jireenyaa fi masjiida tokko ibiddaan gubuu irraa kan ka'e, maatiin hedduun lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf gandaa gadhiisanii ba'uuf dirqamaniiru. Kunis haleellaan qotee bulaan Israa'el naannichatti raawwatan sadarkaa ol'aanaa irra ga'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Why London’s Hackney Council wants to repeal its ‘twin’ status with Haifa
english: Hackney Council in London is set to vote on ending its decades-old twinning partnership with the Israeli city of Haifa. This initiative, championed by the Green Party, serves as a protest against Israel’s ongoing military actions in Gaza. While the partnership has been inactive for years, the council aims to formally terminate the agreement to address local calls for solidarity with Palestinians.
amharic: የለንደኑ የሃክኒ ካውንስል ከእስራኤሏ ሃይፋ ከተማ ጋር ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የነበረውን የአጋርነት ግንኙነት ለማቋረጥ በድምፅ ለመወሰን ተዘጋጅቷል። ይህ በአረንጓዴ ፓርቲ የተጀመረው ውሳኔ፣ እስራኤል በጋዛ የምታካሂደውን ጦርነት በመቃወም የሚደረግ እርምጃ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ግንኙነቱ ከዓመታት በፊት ቢቆምም፣ ካውንስሉ ከፍልስጤማውያን ጋር ያለውን አጋርነት ለማሳየት ይህንን ስምምነት በይፋ ለመሰረዝ አቅዷል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi magaalaa Landan kan ta'e Hackney, hariiroo waggoota dheeraaf biyya Israa'el magaalaa Haifa waliin qabu dhaabuuf murteessuuf qophiirra jira. Tarkaanfiin kun kan jalqabame dhaabbata 'Green Party' yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas waraana Israa'el Gaazaatti gaggeessaa jirtu mormuudha. Hariiroon kun waggoota hedduuf hojii ala kan ture ta'us, bulchiinsi magaalaan sun deeggarsa isaa fiilisxeemotaaf qabu ibsuuf waligaltee kana seeraan haqachuuf murteesseera.

title: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
english: The US delegation walked out of a UN Security Council meeting to protest remarks made by France that criticized the American stance on human rights. The disagreement began after the US voted against reappointing UN human rights chief Volker Turk, leading France to compare the US position to that of authoritarian nations. US officials vowed to continue these protests until France stops its disrespectful criticism, signaling growing friction between Washington and the United Nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የልዑካን ቡድን ፈረንሳይ በአሜሪካ የሰብአዊ መብት አቋም ላይ የሰነዘረችውን ትችት በመቃወም ከተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ስብሰባ ወጥተዋል። አለመግባባቱ የተፈጠረው አሜሪካ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብት ኮሚሽነር ቮልከር ተርክ በድጋሚ እንዳይመረጡ ድምጽ በመስጠቷ ሲሆን ፈረንሳይ ይህንን ድርጊት አምባገነን ሀገራት ከሚወስዱት አቋም ጋር በማነጻጸሯ ነው። የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች ፈረንሳይ ትችቷን እስካላቆመች ድረስ ተቃውሟቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ ገልጸው፣ ይህም በአሜሪካ እና በተባበሩት መንግስታት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት መሻከሩን አመላክቷል።
oromo: Miseensonni ergamtoota Ameerikaa, Faransaay dhimma mirga namoomaa irratti yaadota ishee qeequu isheetiin mormuuf walgahii Mana Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii keessaa bahan. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan jalqabe Ameerikaan komishinara mirga namoomaa UN Volkar Turk irra deebiin akka hin filatamne sagalee kennuu isheetiin booda, Faransaay immoo gocha kana biyyoota bulchiinsa abbaa irree waliin wal-bira qabuu isheetiin dha. Jilaan Ameerikaa hanga Faransaay qeeqaa ishee kana dhaabduutti mormii isaanii akka itti fufan ibsuun, walitti dhufeenyi Ameerikaa fi Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii gidduu jiru hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Zidane confirmed as France head coach
english: Zinedine Zidane has officially been appointed as the new head coach of the French national football team. He replaces Didier Deschamps, who stepped down following a 14-year tenure that ended after the 2026 World Cup. The legendary former midfielder will lead the squad through the 2030 World Cup qualifying campaign, with his first match scheduled for late September.
amharic: ዚነዲን ዚዳን የፈረንሳይ ብሄራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን አዲሱ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በይፋ ተሹመዋል። የፈረንሳይ ብሄራዊ ቡድንን ለ14 ዓመታት የመሩት ዲዲየር ዴሻምፕ ከ2026 የዓለም ዋንጫ በኋላ ከኃላፊነታቸው ለቀዋል። ታዋቂው የቀድሞ የፈረንሳይ ኮከብ ተጫዋች ቡድኑን እስከ 2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ ድረስ እንዲመሩ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Ziinediin Ziidaan leenjisaa garee biyyoolessa Faransaay haaraa ta'uun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Inni kan bakka bu'e Didiiye Deeshaamp kan waggoota 14f garee kana hogganaa ture yoo ta'u, inniis erga Waancaa Addunyaa 2026 booda hojiisaa gadi lakkiseera. Leenjisaan sun garee kana hanga dorgommii waancaa addunyaa bara 2030tti kan hogganu ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Zinedine Zidane named new France head coach following World Cup
english: Zinedine Zidane has been officially appointed as the new head coach of the French national football team. He replaces Didier Deschamps, who stepped down following the team's semifinal exit at the 2026 World Cup. Zidane is set to begin his leadership role in upcoming UEFA Nations League matches against Turkiye and Italy.
amharic: ዚነዲን ዚዳን የፈረንሳይ ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን አዲሱ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተሹመዋል። እርሳቸው የተሾሙት ዲዲዬ ዴሻምፕ በ2026 የዓለም ዋንጫ ግማሽ ፍፃሜ ከተሰናበቱ በኋላ ስልጣናቸውን መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። ዚዳን አዲሱን ኃላፊነታቸውን በቅርቡ በሚካሄዱ የዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታዎች ከቱርክ እና ጣሊያን ጋር ይጀምራሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ziinediin Ziidaan leenjisaa garee biyyoolessa Faransaay haaraa ta'uun muudamaniiru. Isaanis kan muudaman leenjisaa duraanii Diidiye Deeshaampii tapha waancaa addunyaa bara 2026 irratti gareen kun erga gufatee booda hojii gadhiisuun isaanii hordofee dha. Ziidaan hojii isaanii kan jalqaban taphoota UEFA Nations League torban dhufu Turkiifi Xaaliyaanii waliin ta'u.

title: Netanyahu in the White House: What’s on the agenda and what’s next?
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has arrived in Washington to meet with President Donald Trump and attend the funeral of Senator Lindsey Graham. The primary focus of their discussion will be the ongoing conflict with Iran and Israel's military operations in Lebanon. Analysts believe Netanyahu is also hoping to gain political support from Trump ahead of the upcoming Israeli elections.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ከፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ለመወያየት እና የሴናተር ሊንዚ ግራሃምን የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት ለመታደም ዋሽንግተን ገብተዋል። የውይይታቸው ዋና ትኩረት ከኢራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት እና በእስራኤል የሚመራው የሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ይሆናል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ኔታንያሁ በመጪው የእስራኤል ምርጫ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ከትራምፕ ጋር እየተገናኙ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netaanyaahuu pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp waliin mari'achuuf fi awwaalcha senaatar Liinzii Giraahamirratti argamuuf gara Waashingitan dhaqaniiru. Mata dureen marii isaanii inni guddaan waraana Iiraan waliin jiru fi duula waraanaa Israa'el biyya Libaanoos keessatti geggeessitu ta'a. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, Netaanyaahuun filannoo Israa'el dhufuuf qophaa'aa jiran kanaaf deeggarsa Traamp argachuuf yaalii gochaa jiru.

title: ‘Future at stake’: India moves to demolish university Muslim leader founded
english: Authorities in India's Uttar Pradesh state have ordered the demolition of 38 buildings at the Mohammad Ali Jauhar University, claiming they were constructed without proper authorization. Established by Muslim politician Azam Khan, the institution now faces uncertainty, prompting students and local supporters to hold continuous protests to protect the campus. While the state administration has granted an temporary stay on the August 5 deadline, university officials are seeking a permanent cancellation of the demolition order to secure the students' academic future.
amharic: የህንድ ኡታር ፕራዴሽ ግዛት ባለስልጣናት በሙስሊሙ መሪ አዛም ካን የተመሰረተው መሀመድ አሊ ጃውሃር ዩኒቨርሲቲ ህገ-ወጥ ናቸው ባሏቸው 38 ህንፃዎች ላይ የማፍረስ ትእዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። በዚህ ውሳኔ የተደናገጡ ተማሪዎች እና ደጋፊዎች ዩኒቨርሲቲውን ለመታደግ ተቃውሞ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። መንግስት የማፍረስ ቀነ-ገደቡን ለጊዜው ቢያቆምም፣ የዩኒቨርሲቲው አስተዳደር ትእዛዙ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲሰረዝ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan naannoo Uttar Piraadesh kan Hindii, Yuunivarsiitii Mohaammad Alii Jauhaar kan hogganaa Musliimaa Azam Kaanin hundaa’e irratti, ijaarsawwan seeraan alaa jedhamaniin gahuu 38 diiguuf ajaja kenneera. Murtee kanaan kan rifatan barattoonniifi deggartoonni dhaabbatichaa, yuunivarsiitichaa ittisuuf mormii gaggeessaa jiru. Mootummaan hanga guyyaa diiggaa kanaan dura ture kaffaltii yeroof kan dhaabe ta’us, hooggantoonni yuunivarsiitichaa ajajichi guutumaatti akka haqamuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Sixty Palestinians detained by Israel return to Gaza, describe abuses
english: Israel recently released 60 Palestinian detainees, who arrived at a Gaza hospital showing signs of severe physical trauma and mistreatment. The men, who had been held for months as unlawful combatants, reported being subjected to brutal violence and harsh living conditions while in custody. Although Israeli authorities claimed they were released after questioning, many of the survivors remain frail and face an uncertain future due to the ongoing humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
amharic: እስራኤል በቅርቡ 60 ፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞችን የለቀቀች ሲሆን፣ እነሱም ከባድ የአካል ጉዳት እና እንግልት የደረሰባቸው መሆኑን በማሳየት ወደ ጋዛ ሆስፒታል ደርሰዋል። ለወራት ያህል ህገ-ወጥ ታጣቂዎች በሚል ታስረው የቆዩት እነዚህ ሰዎች፣ በእስር ቤት ውስጥ በነበሩበት ጊዜ ከፍተኛ ድብደባ እና አስከፊ ሁኔታዎች እንደደረሰባቸው ተናግረዋል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ ከተደረገ በኋላ እንደለቀቋቸው ቢገልጹም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ተጎጂዎች በጋዛ ባለው አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ምክንያት የከፋ የጤና እክል እና የኑሮ ችግር ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Israa'el dhiheenya kana hidhamtoota Palastiiyn 60 ta'an gadi lhiiste; namoonni kunneenis miidhaa qaamaa fi gidiraa hamaa keessa turuu isaanii ibsuun gara hospitaala Gaazaatti geessifamaniiru. Namoonni kunneen ji'oota hedduuf 'kombataantii seeraan alaa' jedhamanii hidhamanii kan turan yoo ta'u, yeroo hidhaa keessa turanitti reebicha suukkanneessaa fi haala jireenyaa hamaa keessa darbuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Aangoonni Israa'el qorannoo booda gadi lhiifamuu isaanii ibsaniyyuu, namoonni kunneen miidhaa qaamaa irra ga'een laaffachuu fi sababa waraana Gaazaatti jiruun jireenyi isaanii gara fuulduraa kan yaaddessu ta'uu hubatameera.

title: Colombia’s president-elect to suspend Palestine embassy
english: Colombia’s incoming president, Abelardo de la Espriella, has announced major changes to the nation's foreign policy. His plan includes canceling the opening of a Palestinian embassy and moving the Colombian embassy to Jerusalem. Additionally, the administration intends to shut down fifteen other diplomatic missions as part of a broad restructuring of international relations.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪዬላ በአገሪቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል። በዚህም መሰረት የፍልስጤም ኤምባሲ እንዲከፈት ተይዞ የነበረውን እቅድ ሰርዘው፣ የኮሎምቢያን ኤምባሲ ወደ እየሩሳሌም ለማዛወር ወስነዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የውጭ ግንኙነት ስትራቴጂያቸውን እንደገና ለማዋቀር ሲባል ሌሎች አስራ አምስት የዲፕሎማሲ ተቋማትን ለመዝጋት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kolombiyaa haaraan filataman Abelardo de la Espriella, jijjiirama guddaa siyaasa alaa biyyattii keessatti akka godhan beeksisaniiru. Karoora isaanii keessatti, banamuun embaasii Filisxeem akka hafuu fi embaasiin Kolombiyaa gara Yerusaalem akka jijjiiramu murteessaniiru. Kana malees, qindoomina siyaasa alaa haaraa diriirsuuf jechuun, embaasiiwwan biyyoota biraa kudha shan akka cufaman taasisaniiru.

title: On the front line of Ecuador's drugs war, police fight gangs, guns and corruption
english: In the Ecuadorian city of Durán, police officers are battling powerful drug gangs while simultaneously fighting deep-rooted corruption within their own ranks and the government. Captain Jean Carlos Bustamante and his team frequently conduct dangerous raids to seize illegal weapons, though they admit the gangs are better funded and heavily armed. These brave officers operate in an environment of extreme fear where local residents are too terrified to speak out against the criminal groups.
amharic: በኢኳዶር ዱራን ከተማ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ ፖሊሶች ከኃይለኛ የአደንዛዥ እፅ ቡድኖች ጋር ከመዋጋታቸው በተጨማሪ በራሳቸው ተቋም እና በመንግስት ውስጥ ስር ሰዶ የሚገኘውን ሙስና ለመታገል እየሞከሩ ነው። ካፒቴን ዣን ካርሎስ ቡስታማንቴ እና ቡድናቸው ህገ-ወጥ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን ለመያዝ አደገኛ ስራዎችን ያከናውናሉ፤ ነገር ግን የወንጀል ቡድኖቹ ከመንግስት በበለጠ የገንዘብ አቅም እና የጦር መሳሪያ እንዳላቸው ይናገራሉ። እነዚህ የፖሊስ አባላት የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ከወንጀለኞች ፍርሃት የተነሳ ዝምታን በመምረጣቸው በጣም አስቸጋሪ በሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa Durán kan biyya Ekwadooritti, poolisonni garee yakkaafi gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochuu waliin lolaniiru; kana malees, dhaabbata isaanii keessaafi mootummaa keessa yakka babal'atee jiru waliin qabsaa'aa jiru. Kaappiteen Jean Carlos Bustamanteefi gareen isaa meeshaalee waraanaa seeraan alaa qabachuuf duula nageenyaa cimaa gaggeessu, ta'us gareen yakka kanaa mootummaa caalaa maallaqaafi meeshaa waraanaa akka qaban himu. Poolisonni kun haala sodaachisaa keessa jiru, sababni isaas jiraattonni naannichaa sodaa garee yakka kanaatiin jecha tokko illee dubbachuu hin danda'an.

title: Palestine weekly: West Bank in flames after Tal killings
english: A violent confrontation erupted in the West Bank after Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian village, leading to a deadly shootout that killed multiple Palestinians, an Israeli settler, and a soldier. In response, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu launched a major military operation involving home demolitions, road closures, and the deployment of 26 army battalions. Government officials have pledged to intensify these measures, creating an atmosphere of widespread destruction and instability throughout the region.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፍልስጤማውያን መንደር ላይ ጥቃት በማድረሳቸው በተፈጠረ ግጭት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን፣ አንድ ሰፋሪ እና አንድ ወታደር ተገድለዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ቤቶችን ማፍረስን፣ መንገዶችን መዝጋትን እና 26 የጦር ሻለቃዎችን ማሰማራትን ያካተተ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አውጀዋል። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እርምጃውን አጠናክረው እንደሚቀጥሉ በመግለጻቸው በክልሉ ከፍተኛ ውድመት እና አለመረጋጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Godina Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti qotee bulaan Israa'el ganda Falasxiin irratti haleellaa erga raawwatanii booda walitti bu'iinsi cimaan uumamee namoonni hedduun du'aniiru. Deebii kanaafis Ministirri Mummee Benyaamiin Netaanyaahuu manneen diigsiisuu, daandiiwwan cufuufi waraana humna 26 gara naannichatti ergachuu dabalatee tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhataniiru. Hoji raawwachiiftonni mootummaa tarkaanfii kana daran jabeeessuuf waadaa galuun naannichatti balleessaa fi tasgabbii dhabuu guddaatu uumameera.

title: Mamdani tackles cost of living crisis in New York with 30% discounts
english: New York City official Zohran Mamdani has introduced a program to help residents deal with rising expenses. The initiative offers grocery baskets at a 30 percent discount compared to standard retail prices. These discounted goods will be available at five city-operated locations to provide financial relief to the public.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ከተማ ባለስልጣን ዞህራን ማምዳኒ ነዋሪዎች እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት እንዲቋቋሙ የሚያግዝ አዲስ እቅድ አስተዋውቀዋል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት፣ መሰረታዊ የምግብ ቁሳቁሶች ካሉበት የገበያ ዋጋ በ30 በመቶ ቅናሽ ይሸጣሉ። እነዚህ ቅናሽ የተደረገባቸው ምርቶች በከተማ አስተዳደሩ በሚተዳደሩ አምስት መደብሮች ለህዝብ ይቀርባሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni magaalaa New York Zohran Mamdani jiraattotni gatii jireenyaa dabale irratti akka salphatuuf sagantaa haaraa qopheessaniiru. Sagantaa kanaan, meeshaaleen nyaataa gatii gabaa idilee irraa dhibbeentaa 30n hir'atanii gurguramu. Meeshaaleen gatii hir'ate kunis kantoonii shan magaalaan bulchitu keessatti ummataaf dhihaatu.

title: Malaysia detains more than 100 Rohingya seeking help from the UN
english: Malaysian authorities have arrested over 100 Rohingya refugees who were attempting to reach the United Nations for assistance after being forced out of their homes. These individuals have faced increasing hostility and harassment due to the spread of false information and hateful rhetoric online. The refugees were seeking safety and support when they were taken into custody by local police.
amharic: የማሌዥያ ፖሊስ ከቤታቸው የተፈናቀሉ እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን እርዳታ ለማግኘት ሲሞክሩ የነበሩ ከ100 በላይ የሮሂንግያ ስደተኞችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። እነዚህ ሰዎች በኢንተርኔት ላይ በሚሰራጩ የጥላቻ ንግግሮች እና የተሳሳቱ መረጃዎች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የሆነ እንግልት እና ጥቃት ሲደርስባቸው ቆይተዋል። እርዳታ ለማግኘት ሲንቀሳቀሱ የነበሩት ስደተኞች በአሁኑ ወቅት በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Poolisiin Maleeziyaa baqattoota Rohingiyaa 100 ol ta'an, manaa erga buqqa'anii booda gargaarsa dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniirraa barbaadaa turan to'annoo jala oolcheera. Namoonni kun miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti ibsa jibbiinsaa fi odeeffannoo sobaa babal'ataa jiruun kanneen miidhaa fi dararaaf saaxilamaa turanidha. Baqattoonni kun gargaarsa barbaadaa osoo jiranii harka poolisiitti kufaniiru.

title: Trump calls protester ‘communist’ after Michigan speech interruption
english: During an automotive event in Michigan, Donald Trump was interrupted by a protester who was subsequently escorted out of the venue. Trump labeled the individual a communist and used the incident to launch a broader critique regarding the perceived danger of communist ideology in the United States. The event highlighted ongoing political tensions during his public appearances.
amharic: ሚቺጋን ውስጥ በተካሄደ የመኪና ዘርፍ ዝግጅት ላይ፣ አንድ ተቃዋሚ ንግግሩን በማስተጓጎሉ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሰውየውን ኮሚኒስት ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል። ተቃዋሚው ከስፍራው እንዲወጣ ከተደረገ በኋላ፣ ትራምፕ ኮሚኒዝም በአሜሪካ ላይ ስላለው አደጋ ሰፋ ያለ ትችት ሰንዝረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ወቅት እየተካረረ የመጣውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Magaalaa Miichiganitti sirna konkolaataa irratti, namni tokko haasaa Donald Trump addaan kutee erga wixxifamee booda iddoo sanaa akka ba'u godhame. Trump namicha kana 'komunistii' jechuun waamanii, boodarras gareen kun biyyattii irratti balaa akka qaban ibsuun komii isaanii bal'isaniiru. Gochi kun marii siyaasaa fi walitti bu'iinsa guyyoota kanneen keessa jiru mul'isa.

title: Israeli ex-generals urge Trump to push Netanyahu on ‘settler terror’
english: Nearly 600 former Israeli military and intelligence officials have sent a letter to President Donald Trump urging him to pressure Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to stop violent settler activities in the West Bank. The group, known as Commanders for Israel’s Security, argues that this rising violence threatens both regional stability and Israel's long-term future. They believe that Trump is the only leader with enough influence to intervene and prevent the situation from escalating into a major catastrophe.
amharic: ከ600 የሚበልጡ የቀድሞ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እና የመረጃ ደህንነት ባለስልጣናት፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚፈጸመውን የአሰፋፋሪዎች ብጥብጥ እንዲያቆም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ ጫና እንዲፈጥሩ ለፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ደብዳቤ ጽፈዋል። 'የእስራኤል ደህንነት አዛዦች' የተሰኘው ይህ ቡድን፣ እየጨመረ የመጣው ጥቃት ለክልሉ መረጋጋት እና ለእስራኤል የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ከፍተኛ ስጋት መሆኑን ይገልጻል። ችግሩን ወደ ትልቅ አደጋ እንዳያድግ ለመከላከል ትራምፕ ብቻ ጣልቃ በመግባት ሁኔታውን ማስተካከል እንደሚችሉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraanaa fi basaastotaa Israa'el durii 600 ta'an, dhimma waldhabdee fi gochaa hammeenyaa qe'ee qabachuu naannawaa Lixa Baankiirratti akka gidduu galan pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraampitti ergaa erganiiru. Gareen 'Commanders for Israel’s Security' jedhamu kun, gochi hammeenyaa kun tasgabbii naannichaa fi fuuldura Israa'elirratti balaa cimaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Pirezidaant Tiraamp qofti dhiibbaa barbaachisu uumee rakkoo kana akka ittisuufi nageenya eeguu akka danda'u gaafataniiru.

title: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5bn to settle baby powder lawsuits
english: Johnson & Johnson has proposed a settlement of up to $5.5 billion to end numerous lawsuits claiming its talc-based baby powder caused ovarian cancer. Although the company maintains that these allegations are baseless and continues to deny wrongdoing, it hopes the payout will finally resolve years of legal challenges. The settlement will only proceed if 95% of the plaintiffs agree to the terms, allowing the firm to move past the controversy.
amharic: ጆንሰን ኤንድ ጆንሰን የሕፃናት ፓውደሩ ኦቫሪያን ካንሰር ያስከትላል ተብሎ የቀረበበትን የበርካታ ዓመታት የክስ ሂደት ለመቋጨት እስከ 5.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለመክፈል አቅርቧል። ኩባንያው የቀረበበት ክስ መሠረተ ቢስ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ጥፋተኛ መሆኑን ባይቀበልም፣ ጉዳዩን በአጠቃላይ ለመዝጋት ክፍያውን ለመፈጸም ተስማምቷል። ይህ ስምምነት ተግባራዊ የሚሆነው 95 በመቶ የሚሆኑት ከሳሾች ክፍያውን ከተቀበሉ ብቻ ሲሆን፣ ኩባንያውም ከዚህ ሕጋዊ ጫና በመላቀቅ ወደ ዋና የሥራ እንቅስቃሴው ለመመለስ አቅዷል።
oromo: Kampaniin Jonson & Jonson daa'immanii isaanii kan 'baby powder' jedhamu kaansarii ofaarii fida jedhamee himatameef, kaffaltii hanga biliyoona 5.5 kaffaluun walii galtee irra ga'uuf yaaleera. Kampaniin kun himannaan kun dhugaa akka hin qabne ibsuun yakka akka hin qabne yoo mirkaneessuuf yaalus, rakkoo waggoota dheeraa ture kana dhaabuuf kaffaltii kana hayyameera. Waliigaltee kana hojii irra oolchuuf himattonni 95% ta'an walii galuu qabu; kunis kampaniichi dhimma kana duubatti dhiisee hojii isaa irratti xiyyeeffachuuf isa gargaara.

title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy set to meet Trump as Iran and Ukraine wars converge
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is scheduled to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House this Tuesday to discuss potential new sanctions against Russia. The proposed legislation, which may also include new penalties for Iran, coincides with escalating tensions following a recent Ukrainian strike on an Iranian vessel suspected of transporting military supplies to Russia. While the two leaders look to strengthen their relationship, Ukraine remains cautious about becoming too deeply involved in broader American conflicts with Iran.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ማክሰኞ ዕለት በዋይት ሃውስ ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ለመገናኘት ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል። ውይይታቸው በሩሲያ እና በኢራን ላይ ሊጣል ስለሚችል አዲስ ማዕቀብ የሚያተኩር ሲሆን፣ ይህም የሆነው ዩክሬን ለሩሲያ የጦር መሳሪያ ሲያጓጉዝ የነበረውን የኢራን መርከብ ካጠቃች በኋላ ነው። ሁለቱ መሪዎች ግንኙነታቸውን ለማጠናከር ቢሞክሩም፣ ዩክሬን ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን ግጭት ጋር በቅርበት መያያዝ እንደማትፈልግ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenski guyyaa Kibxata kana Mana Adii keessatti pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp waliin walarguuf qophaa'aniiru. Mariin kun ragaa haaraa Rashiyaafi Iraan irratti gatamuu danda'u kan ilaallatu yoo ta'u, kunis ta'e kan itti aane erga Yukreen doonii Iraan kan meeshaa waraanaa gara Rashiyaatti fe'aa turte haleeltee booda. Hogganoonni lamaan kun hariiroo isaanii cimsachuuf kan yaalan ta'us, Yukreen walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu jiru keessatti of dabaluu akka hin barbaadne eerameera.

title: US warns hundreds of Boeing jets may require seat safety inspections
english: The US Federal Aviation Administration has proposed mandatory safety inspections for 453 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft due to concerns over incorrectly installed seats. Authorities warn that these seats could detach during emergencies, posing a significant risk of injury and preventing passengers from evacuating safely. While the order currently applies only to US-registered planes, Boeing is cooperating with the regulators to address these potential safety hazards.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል አቪዬሽን አስተዳደር በቦይንግ 737 ማክስ አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ወንበሮች በትክክል ባለመገጠማቸው ምክንያት 453 አውሮፕላኖች የደህንነት ምርመራ እንዲደረግባቸው አሳስቧል። እነዚህ ወንበሮች በአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ሁኔታዎች ውስጥ ሊላቀቁ ስለሚችሉ ተሳፋሪዎችን ለአደጋ እንደሚዳርጉ እና የመውጫ መንገዶችን እንደሚዘጉ ባለሥልጣናቱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ትዕዛዙ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ ለተመዘገቡ አውሮፕላኖች ብቻ የሚሠራ ቢሆንም፣ ቦይንግ ይህንን ችግር ለመፍታት ከቁጥጥር አካላት ጋር እየሠራ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Bilisummaa Qilleensaa Ameerikaa (FAA) xiyyaarota Boeing 737 MAX 453 irratti teessifni sirriitti waan hin hidhamneef qormaanni nageenyaa akka godhamuuf yaada dhiyeesseera. Teessifni kun yoo rakkoon mudate akka buqqa’uu danda’anii fi miidhaa qaamaa geessisuu akkasumas namoonni gubbaadhaa akka hin baane dhorkuu akka danda’an akeekkachiiseera. Ajajni kun kan ilaalu xiyyaarota Ameerikaa keessatti galmaa’aniif qofa ta’us, dhaabbanni Boeing rakkoo kana furuuf qaamota olaanoo waliin qindoominaan hojjechaa jira.

title: Trump says Iran talks taking place during pause in US military strikes
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States is currently engaged in discussions with Iran while military operations are temporarily halted. He expressed optimism about reaching a positive agreement through these talks. However, he also clarified that if these diplomatic efforts do not succeed, the U.S. remains prepared to restart military action.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሁኑ ወቅት አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ድርድር እያደረገች መሆኑንና ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎቿን ለጊዜው እንዳቆመች ገልጸዋል። በነዚህ ንግግሮች አማካኝነት የሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነት መፍትሄ እንደሚያገኝ ተስፋ እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል። ሆኖም ድርድሩ ካልተሳካ አሜሪካ ወደ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ለመመለስ ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traamp amma yeroo ammaa kana Ameerikaan Iiraan waliin marii irra akka jirtuu fi tarkaanfii waraanaa yeroodhaaf dhaabdee akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Marii kanaan furmaata gaariin akka argamu abdii akka qaban dubbataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, mariin kun milkaa'uu baannaan, Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa itti fufuuf qophii ta'uu ishee hubachiisaniiru.

title: Ebola response workers strike in DR Congo as death toll spikes
english: Healthcare workers at an Ebola treatment center in the Democratic Republic of Congo have initiated a strike due to two months of unpaid wages. This labor action occurs while the country faces a significant surge in Ebola cases, with the death toll now exceeding 1,400. The situation threatens to disrupt critical medical care as the outbreak continues to escalate.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የኢቦላ ህክምና ማዕከል የሚሰሩ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ለሁለት ወራት ያህል ደሞዝ ስላልተከፈላቸው ስራ አቁመዋል። ይህ የሰራተኞች አድማ የተካሄደው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ተባብሶ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ1,400 በልጠው ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ይህም ለበሽተኞች እየተሰጠ ያለውን ወሳኝ የህክምና አገልግሎት ለአደጋ የጣለ ነው።
oromo: Hojjettoonni fayyaa biyya Koongoo (DRC) keessatti argamu kanneen waldaa yaala Ebola keessa hojjetan, ji'a lamaaf kaffaltii hin arganne jechuun hojii dhaabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo duuti Ebola 1,400 caaleetti dabalaa jiru kanatti. Haalli kun tajaajila yaalaa barbaachisaa ta'e irratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'a.

title: How telehealth is helping close the healthcare gap in rural Zimbabwe
english: A new telehealth program in rural Zimbabwe is helping bridge the medical gap by connecting remote patients with doctors through video consultations. This initiative allows people to receive diagnoses and treatment locally, saving them from long, expensive journeys to distant hospitals. By utilizing digital technology, the service helps overcome the shortage of medical professionals and resources currently affecting the country's rural healthcare system.
amharic: በገጠር ዚምባብዌ የተጀመረው አዲስ የቴሌ-ጤና ፕሮግራም ታማሚዎች ከሩቅ ቦታዎች ሆነው በቪዲዮ አማካኝነት ከሀኪሞች ጋር እንዲገናኙ በማድረግ የጤና አገልግሎት ክፍተትን እየሞላ ነው። ይህ ተነሳሽነት ሰዎች በአቅራቢያቸው ምርመራ እና ህክምና እንዲያገኙ በማድረግ፣ ወደ ሩቅ ከተሞች ለመጓዝ የሚያስፈልገውን ከፍተኛ ወጪ እና ጊዜ እንዲቆጥቡ አስችሏቸዋል። በቴክኖሎጂ የታገዘው ይህ አገልግሎት በገጠር አካባቢዎች የሚስተዋለውን የባለሙያዎች እና የህክምና መሳሪያዎች እጥረት ለመቅረፍ ትልቅ ሚና እየተጫወተ ነው።
oromo: Sagantaan 'telehealth' jedhamu kan baadiyyaa biyya Ziimbaabuwee keessatti jalqabame, namoonni bakka fagoo jiran ogeeyyee fayyaa wajjin viidiyoon akka wal arguuf gargaaraa jira. Tajaajilli kun namoonni bakka jiranitti murtii fayyaa fi wal'ansa akka argatan gochuun, gara magaalaatti imaluuf baasii fi yeroo isaanitti ta'u hambiseera. Teeknooloojii kana fayyadamuun, hanqina ogeeyyee fayyaa fi meeshaalee yaalaa naannoo baadiyyaatti mudatu furuuf carraa guddaa uumeera.

title: Drone attacks, blasts reported in northern Iraq
english: Multiple drone attacks were launched against several locations in northern Iraq on Tuesday, leading to explosions across the Kurdistan region. Air defense systems managed to intercept and destroy these incoming drones near Erbil and Soran. At this time, there have been no reports regarding injuries or property destruction resulting from these incidents.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በሰሜን ኢራቅ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በድሮኖች ጥቃት ተፈጽሞ ነበር፣ ይህም በኩርዲስታን ክልል ውስጥ የፍንዳታ ድምጾች እንዲሰሙ አድርጓል። የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት በአርቢል እና በሶራን አቅራቢያ የነበሩ ድሮኖችን መትቶ መጣል ችሏል። እስካሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት ከጥቃቱ ጋር በተያያዘ የደረሰ ጉዳት ወይም የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት አልተዘገበም።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe kana naannoo kaaba Iraaq bakkeewwan hedduutti haleellaan xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) raawwatamee ture, kunis naannoo Kurdistan keessatti sagalee dhooyinsaatiin akka dhaga'amu godheera. Humnoonni ittisa qilleensaa Erbil fi Soran biratti xiyyaarota kanneen irraa ittisuun barbadeessaniiru. Yeroo ammaa kanatti haleellaa kanaan walqabatee miidhaan qaamaa ykn kan qabeenyaa gahuu isaa ibsame hin jiru.

title: Netanyahu arrives in Washington ahead of meeting with Trump
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has reached Washington to hold discussions with US President Donald Trump. Their meeting is expected to focus on regional conflicts involving Iran and potential peace negotiations concerning Lebanon. Additionally, the leaders plan to review strategies for broadening the Abraham Accords.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ለመወያየት ዋሽንግተን ገብተዋል። መሪዎቹ በዋናነት ኢራንን በሚመለከት ስላለው ጦርነት እና ሊባኖስን ሰላም ለማድረግ ስለሚቻልበት ሁኔታ ይመክራሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። እንዲሁም የአብርሃም ስምምነትን ለማስፋት በሚቻልበት መንገድ ላይ ይወያያሉ ተብሎ ይገመታል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu marii Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp waliin taasisaniif gara Waashingitan qaqqabaniiru. Maree isaanii irratti waraana Iraan waliin jiru fi carraawwan nagaa biyya Libaanoos waliin uumamu danda'an irratti akka mari'atan eegama. Kana malees, gamtaan kun yaada walii galtee Abrahaam bal'isuuf marii ni godhu.

title: Palestinians in the West Bank face increasing Israeli military raids, settler violence
english: Palestinians living in the West Bank are facing severe pressure due to frequent Israeli military operations and attacks by settlers. Following a violent confrontation in the village of Tal that resulted in multiple deaths on both sides, Israeli forces have intensified their presence in the area. This crackdown has led to the detention of at least 60 Palestinians, worsening an already volatile and dangerous situation for the local population.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎች እና በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። በታል መንደር በተፈጠረ ግጭት የሁለቱም ወገን ሰዎች ህይወት ካለፈ በኋላ፣ የእስራኤል ጦር በአካባቢው ያለውን እንቅስቃሴ አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል። በዚህም ሳቢያ ቢያንስ 60 ፍልስጤማውያን በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ እጅግ አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Ummanni Falasxiin naannoo West Bank jedhamu keessa jiraatan, waraana Israa'elii fi haleellaa warra lafa qabatan irraa dhufuun dhiphina cimaa keessa jiru. Magaala Tal keessatti walitti bu'iinsa lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafate booda, waraanni Israa'el naannichatti duula isaa hammaateera. Hojiin waraanaa kunis namoota Falasxiin 60 ta'an hidhamuu kan hordofsiise yoo ta'u, haalli naannichaa guyyaa gara guyyaatti hammaachaa dhufeera.

title: Israel, Lebanon talks set for Rome next week
english: Israeli and Lebanese representatives are scheduled to meet in Rome from August 4 to 6 to hold talks mediated by the United States. The goal of this meeting is to move forward with a framework agreement that addresses border disputes and establishes a broader peace and security arrangement. Officials intend to build on existing pilot programs to stabilize the region.

title: Trump says US having 'good ‌talks' with Iran
english: Former President Donald Trump recently indicated that the United States is engaged in productive negotiations with Iran, suggesting a potential for a peaceful agreement. While he expressed optimism about these diplomatic efforts, he also maintained a firm stance, stating that the U.S. would continue its previous approach if the talks fail. These developments follow a period of military tension, as the U.S. recently paused its strikes against Iran.

title: China's new challenge as natural disasters strike - fake AI videos
english: China is facing a growing problem with realistic AI-generated fake videos spreading misinformation during natural disasters like typhoons and floods. These deceptive clips, which include fabricated scenes of crocodiles or false reports of emergency situations, are causing public panic and confusion. Authorities have begun punishing those who create this content to gain online popularity, but experts warn that the ease of using AI makes controlling this flood of misinformation extremely difficult.
amharic: ቻይና በተፈጥሮ አደጋዎች ወቅት በተንሰራፋው አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ (AI) አማካኝነት በሚፈጠሩ ሐሰተኛ ቪዲዮዎች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ተግዳሮት ገጥሟታል። እነዚህ ሐሰተኛ ምስሎችና መረጃዎች በሕዝብ ዘንድ ድንጋጤን እየፈጠሩ በመሆናቸው ባለሥልጣናት አሰራጮቹን በሕግ እየቀጡ ይገኛሉ። ቢሆንም፣ የቴክኖሎጂው ቀላልነት የሐሰተኛ መረጃዎችን ስርጭት ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ እንዳደረገው ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።

title: J&J offers $5.5bn settlement in lawsuits claiming talc link to cancer
english: Johnson & Johnson has proposed a $5.5 billion settlement to resolve nearly 69,000 lawsuits in the United States involving claims that its talc-based baby powder causes ovarian cancer. While the company maintains that its products are safe, they discontinued talc powders globally following widespread health concerns and classification by the WHO as a probable carcinogen. This agreement settles the vast majority of US litigation, though it does not impact a significant ongoing legal case in the United Kingdom.
